Abstract Platform.en_definition: A Software Platform defined by AUTOSAR for the definition of functional level communications independent of Classic / Adaptive / Offboard deployments.
Abstract Platform.zh: AUTOSAR 定义的一种软件平台，用于以独立于经典平台（Classic）/ 自适应平台（Adaptive）/ 离板（Offboard）部署方式的方式定义功能级通信。

Acceptance Test Suite.en_definition: A test case description used in the context of Acceptance Testing
Acceptance Test Suite.zh: 在验收测试（**Acceptance Testing**）语境中使用的一种测试用例描述。

Access Control Decision.en_definition: The Access Control Decision is a Boolean value indicating if the requested operation is permitted or not. It is based on the identity of the caller and the 'Access Control Policy'
Access Control Decision.zh: 访问控制判定是一个布尔值，指示所请求的操作是否被允许。它基于调用者的身份以及"访问控制策略"（**Access Control Policy**）。

Access Control Policy.en_definition: Access Control Policies are bound to the targets of calls (i.e. Service interfaces) and are used to express what 'Identity Information' is necessary to access those interfaces.
Access Control Policy.zh: 访问控制策略绑定到调用的目标（即服务接口），用于表达访问这些接口需要何种"身份信息"（**Identity Information**）。

Adaptability.en_definition: Adaptability is the ability of a system to adjust itself to changed circumstances in its environment in order to continue to provide the intended functionality.
Adaptability.zh: 适应性是系统调整自身以应对其环境变化、从而继续提供预期功能的能力。

Adaptive Application.en_definition: Software that follows the Adaptive AUTOSAR specifications and therefore can be deployed onto an Adaptive Platform instance. It consists of its implementation, operational data (e.g. map data) and its meta-data given by the Application Design Model. An Adaptive Application contains at least one executable. In order to be deployable on different Adaptive Platforms, it only uses ARA programming interfaces.
Adaptive Application.zh: 遵循自适应 AUTOSAR 规范、因而可部署到自适应平台实例上的软件。它由其实现、运行数据（如地图数据）以及由应用设计模型给出的元数据组成。自适应应用至少包含一个可执行文件。为了能部署到不同的自适应平台上，它只使用 ARA 编程接口。

Adaptive Platform Foundation.en_definition: Part of an Adaptive Platform implementation, which provides standardized platform functionality to Applications via software interfaces (APIs).
Adaptive Platform Foundation.zh: 自适应平台实现的一部分，通过软件接口（API）向应用提供标准化的平台功能。

Adaptive Platform Services.en_definition: Standard platform services that is provided by an application which is part of AUTOSAR platform implementation.
Adaptive Platform Services.zh: 由属于 AUTOSAR 平台实现一部分的应用所提供的标准平台服务。

Application.en_definition: A software (or program) that is specified to the solution of a problem of an end user requiring information processing for its solution. The 'Software Configuration' of a software entity.
Application.zh: 为解决需要信息处理的最终用户问题而规定的软件（或程序）。一个软件实体的"软件配置"（**Software Configuration**）。

Application Interface.en_definition: A 'Port Interface' used by a 'Software Component' as specified in the software component template.
Application Interface.zh: 软件组件模板中所规定的、由"软件组件"（**Software Component**）使用的"端口接口"（**Port Interface**）。

Application Programming Interface.en_definition: An Application Programming Interface (API) is the prescribed method of a specific software part by which a programmer writing a program can make requests to that software part.
Application Programming Interface.zh: 应用编程接口（API）是特定软件部分的既定方法，编写程序的程序员通过它可以向该软件部分发出请求。

Application Software Component.en_definition: An Application Software Component is a specific 'Software Component' which realizes a defined functionality on application level and runs on the AUTOSAR infrastructure. It communicates only through the AUTOSAR Runtime Environment.
Application Software Component.zh: 应用软件组件是一种特定的"软件组件"，它在应用层实现已定义的功能并运行于 AUTOSAR 基础设施之上。它只通过 AUTOSAR 运行时环境进行通信。

Architecture.en_definition: The fundamental organization of a system embodied in its components, their static and dynamic relationships to each other, and to the environment, and the principles guiding its design and evolution.
Architecture.zh: 体系结构是系统的基本组织方式，体现在其组件、组件之间及其与环境的静态与动态关系、以及指导其设计与演化的原则之中。

Artifact.en_definition: This is a Work Product Definition that provides a description and definition for tangible work product types. Artifacts may be composed of other artifacts. At a high level, an artifact is represented as a single conceptual file.
Artifact.zh: 制品是一种工作产品定义（**Work Product Definition**），为有形的工作产品类型提供描述与定义。制品可以由其他制品组成。在高层次上，制品表示为单个概念性文件。

Asserted Property.en_definition: A property or quality of a design entity (e.g. SW component or system) is asserted, if the design entity guarantees that this property or quality is fulfilled.
Asserted Property.zh: 如果设计实体（例如软件组件或系统）保证该属性或质量得到满足，则称设计实体的该属性或质量是"已断言的"（**asserted**）。

Asset.en_definition: An item that has been designed for use in multiple contexts.
Asset.zh: 为在多种上下文中使用而设计的条目。

Asynchronous Communication.en_definition: Asynchronous communication does not block the sending software entity. The sending software entity continues its operation without getting a response from the communication partner(s).
Asynchronous Communication.zh: 异步通信不会阻塞发送方软件实体。发送方软件实体无需等待通信伙伴的响应即可继续其自身的操作。

Asynchronous Function.en_definition: A 'Function' is called asynchronous if the described functionality is not guaranteed to be completed the moment the function returns to the caller.
Asynchronous Function.zh: 如果某个"函数"（**Function**）所描述的功能在其返回调用者时不能保证已完成，则该函数称为异步函数。

Authenticity.en_definition: The property that data originated from its purported source.
Authenticity.zh: 数据确实来源于其所声称来源的特性。

AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform.en_definition: An adaptive computing platform standardized by AUTOSAR. In a narrow term, it refers to its specification. In a broad term, it may refer to an instance of Adaptive Platform implementation.
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform.zh: 由 AUTOSAR 标准化的自适应计算平台。狭义上指其规范；广义上可指自适应平台实现的一个实例。

AUTOSAR Application Interface.en_definition: A set of Blueprints ('Blueprint') which are standardized by AUTOSAR and which can be used for creating AUTOSAR Interfaces ('AUTOSAR Interface') of an 'Application'. AUTOSAR interfaces that are derived from Standardized Blueprints ('Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint') are Standardized AUTOSAR Interfaces ('Standardized AUTOSAR Interface').
AUTOSAR Application Interface.zh: 由 AUTOSAR 标准化、可用于创建"应用"（**Application**）的"AUTOSAR 接口"（**AUTOSAR Interface**）的一组"蓝图"（**Blueprint**）。从标准化蓝图（**Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint**）派生的 AUTOSAR 接口即标准化的 AUTOSAR 接口（**Standardized AUTOSAR Interface**）。

AUTOSAR Authoring Tool.en_definition: An AUTOSAR Tool used to create and modify AUTOSAR XML descriptions ('AUTOSAR XML description').
AUTOSAR Authoring Tool.zh: 用于创建和修改"AUTOSAR XML 描述"（**AUTOSAR XML description**）的 AUTOSAR 工具（**AUTOSAR Tool**）。

AUTOSAR Blueprint.en_definition: An AUTOSAR Blueprint is a 'Blueprint' for an AUTOSAR element. It also includes that it is specified within the AUTOSAR project which attributes are mandatory to be specified for the blueprint of a specific class of AUTOSAR element types as well as how to derive an AUTOSAR object from that blueprint.
AUTOSAR Blueprint.zh: AUTOSAR 蓝图是 AUTOSAR 元素的"蓝图"（**Blueprint**）。它还包括：在 AUTOSAR 项目中规定，对于某一特定类别的 AUTOSAR 元素类型的蓝图，哪些属性是必须规定的，以及如何从该蓝图派生出 AUTOSAR 对象。

AUTOSAR Converter Tool.en_definition: An AUTOSAR Tool used to create AUTOSAR XML files by converting information from other AUTOSAR XML files.
AUTOSAR Converter Tool.zh: 通过转换其他 AUTOSAR XML 文件中的信息来创建 AUTOSAR XML 文件的 AUTOSAR 工具。

AUTOSAR Definition.en_definition: This is the definition of parameters which can have values. One could say that the parameter values are instances of the definitions. But in the meta-model hierarchy of AUTOSAR, definitions are also instances of the meta-model and therefore considered as a description.
AUTOSAR Definition.zh: 这是对可以有取值的参数的定义。可以说，参数值是这些定义的实例。但在 AUTOSAR 的元模型层次结构中，定义本身也是元模型的实例，因此被视为一种描述。

AUTOSAR Interface.en_definition: The AUTOSAR Interface of a software component refers to the collection of all Ports ('Port') of that component through which it interacts with other components.
AUTOSAR Interface.zh: 软件组件的 AUTOSAR 接口（**AUTOSAR Interface**）指该组件中用于与其他组件交互的所有"端口"（**Port**）的集合。

AUTOSAR Meta-model.en_definition: The AUTOSAR meta-model is a UML2.0 model that defines the language for describing AUTOSAR systems and related artifacts.
AUTOSAR Meta-model.zh: AUTOSAR 元模型是一个 UML2.0 模型，它定义了描述 AUTOSAR 系统及相关制品的语言。

AUTOSAR Model.en_definition: This is an instance of the AUTOSAR meta-model. The AUTOSAR Model represents aspects suitable to the intended use according to the AUTOSAR methodology.
AUTOSAR Model.zh: 这是 AUTOSAR 元模型的一个实例。AUTOSAR 模型表示按照 AUTOSAR 方法论适合预期用途的各个方面。

AUTOSAR Partial Model.en_definition: In AUTOSAR, the possible partitioning of models is marked in the meta-model by <<atp Splitable>>. One partial model is represented in an 'AUTOSAR XML description' by one file. The partial model does not need to fulfill all semantic constraints applicable to an AUTOSAR model.
AUTOSAR Partial Model.zh: 在 AUTOSAR 中，模型可能的划分方式在元模型中用 <<atp Splitable>> 标记。一个部分模型在一个"AUTOSAR XML 描述"（**AUTOSAR XML description**）中由一个文件表示。部分模型不需要满足适用于 AUTOSAR 模型的全部语义约束。

AUTOSAR Processor Tool.en_definition: An AUTOSAR Tool used to create non-AUTOSAR files by processing information from AUTOSAR XML files.
AUTOSAR Processor Tool.zh: 通过处理 AUTOSAR XML 文件中的信息来创建非 AUTOSAR 文件的 AUTOSAR 工具。

AUTOSAR Runtime for Adaptive Application.en_definition: A set of standard application interfaces provided by Functional Clusters, which belong to either Adaptive Platform Foundation or Adaptive Platform Services.
AUTOSAR Runtime for Adaptive Application.zh: 由功能簇（**Functional Cluster**）提供的一组标准应用接口，这些功能簇属于自适应平台基础（**Adaptive Platform Foundation**）或自适应平台服务（**Adaptive Platform Services**）。

AUTOSAR Run-Time Interface.en_definition: The AUTOSAR Run-Time Interface shall define an interface between build tools and debugging/ tracing tools.
AUTOSAR Run-Time Interface.zh: AUTOSAR 运行时接口（AUTOSAR Run-Time Interface）应定义构建工具与调试/跟踪工具之间的接口。

AUTOSAR Service.en_definition: The term service is used in the layered software architecture to denote the highest layer of the AUTOSAR software architecture that interacts with the application. The term service is used in the meaning defined by the service-oriented architecture. This meaning has the strongest relation to the usage of the term service on the AUTOSAR adaptive platform. The term service is also used to describe the handling of diagnostic services, e.g.UDS service ReadDataByIdentifier, for the communication between a diagnostic tester and a diagnostic stack on an (AUTOSAR) ECU.
AUTOSAR Service.zh: "服务"（**service**）一词在分层软件架构中用于表示与应用交互的 AUTOSAR 软件架构的最高层。服务一词按面向服务架构（**service-oriented architecture**）中定义的含义使用。该含义与 AUTOSAR 自适应平台上服务一词的用法关联最强。服务一词也用于描述诊断服务的处理，例如 UDS 服务 ReadDataByIdentifier，用于诊断测试仪与（AUTOSAR）ECU 上的诊断协议栈之间的通信。

AUTOSAR Software.en_definition: Application Software or Basic/Platform Software developed according to the AUTOSAR standard
AUTOSAR Software.zh: 按照 AUTOSAR 标准开发的应用软件或基础/平台软件。

AUTOSAR Tool.en_definition: This is a software tool which supports one or more tasks defined as AUTOSAR tasks in the methodology. Depending on the supported tasks, an AUTOSAR tool can act as an 'AUTOSAR Authoring Tool', an 'AUTOSAR Converter Tool', an 'AUTOSAR Processor Tool' or as a combination of those.
AUTOSAR Tool.zh: 这是一种软件工具，它支持方法论中定义的 AUTOSAR 任务中的一个或多个任务。根据所支持的任务，AUTOSAR 工具可以用作"AUTOSAR 编写工具"（**AUTOSAR Authoring Tool**）、"AUTOSAR 转换工具"（**AUTOSAR Converter Tool**）、"AUTOSAR 处理工具"（**AUTOSAR Processor Tool**），或它们的组合。

AUTOSAR XML description.en_definition: In AUTOSAR this is a serialized AUTOSAR model. In fact an AUTOSAR XML description is the XML representation of an 'AUTOSAR Model'. The AUTOSAR XML description can consist of several files. Each individual file represents an 'AUTOSAR Partial Model' and must validate successfully against the 'AUTOSAR XML Schema'.
AUTOSAR XML description.zh: 在 AUTOSAR 中，这是序列化的 AUTOSAR 模型。实际上，AUTOSAR XML 描述是"AUTOSAR 模型"（**AUTOSAR Model**）的 XML 表示。AUTOSAR XML 描述可以由多个文件组成。每个单独的文件表示一个"AUTOSAR 部分模型"（**AUTOSAR Partial Model**），并且必须能够针对"AUTOSAR XML 模式"（**AUTOSAR XML Schema**）成功通过校验。

AUTOSAR XML Schema.en_definition: The AUTOSAR XML Schema is an XML language definition for exchanging AUTOSAR Models ('AUTOSAR Model') and descriptions.
AUTOSAR XML Schema.zh: AUTOSAR XML 模式是用于交换 AUTOSAR 模型（**AUTOSAR Model**）及描述的 XML 语言定义。

Availability.en_definition: 1. Availability is the ability of the system to perform a function A completely according to its specification. 2. The ratio of the total time the system is performing a function A (according to 1) during a given interval to the length of the interval. Alternative: The probability that the system is performing the function A at a specified time t 3. In a degraded mode the system has the ability to perform a subset B of A if full A is not available. In this case, the functionality B is available.
Availability.zh: 1. 可用性是系统按照其规范完整地执行某个功能 A 的能力。2. 在给定时间间隔内系统执行功能 A（按第 1 条定义）的总时间与该时间间隔长度之比。另一种表述：系统在指定时刻 t 正在执行功能 A 的概率。3. 在降级模式下，如果完整的 A 不可用，系统具有执行 A 的子集 B 的能力。此时，功能 B 是可用的。

Basic Software.en_definition: The Basic Software (BSW) provides the infrastructural (schematic dependent and schematic independent) functionalities of an 'Electronic Control Unit'. It consists of 'Integration Code' and 'Standard Software'.
Basic Software.zh: 基础软件（**Basic Software**, BSW）提供"电子控制单元"（**Electronic Control Unit**）的基础设施功能（依赖于原理图的和独立于原理图的）。它由"集成代码"（**Integration Code**）和"标准软件"（**Standard Software**）组成。

Basic Software Module.en_definition: A collection of software files (code and description) that define a certain basic software functionality present on an 'Electronic Control Unit'.
Basic Software Module.zh: 在"电子控制单元"（**Electronic Control Unit**）上定义某个特定基础软件功能的软件文件（代码与描述）的集合。

Bit Position.en_definition: In AUTOSAR the bit position N within an I-PDU denotes the bit I, with I = N modulo 8, within the byte J, with J = N / 8. The byte J and bit position I is interpreted in accordance to the definition in ISO 17356-4 (OSEK/VDX Communication).
Bit Position.zh: 在 AUTOSAR 中，I-PDU 内的位位置 N 表示字节 J 中的位 I，其中 I = N mod 8，J = N / 8。字节 J 和位位置 I 按照 ISO 17356-4（OSEK/VDX 通信）中的定义进行解释。

Blueprint.en_definition: This is a model from which other models can be derived by copy and refinement. Note that in contrast to meta-model resp. types, this process is not an instantiation.
Blueprint.zh: 这是一种模型，其他模型可以通过复制和细化从中派生。注意，与元模型及类型相对照，这一过程不是实例化。

Bulk Data.en_definition: "Bulk Data" is a set of data such big in size, that standard mechanisms used to handle smaller data sets become inconvenient. This implies that bulk data in a software system are modeled, stored, accessed and transported by different mechanisms than smaller data sets.
Bulk Data.zh: "批量数据"（**Bulk Data**）是指规模大到处理较小数据集的标准机制不再适用的一类数据。这意味着软件系统中的批量数据需要用不同于较小数据集的机制来建模、存储、访问和传输。

Bus Mirroring.en_definition: Forwarding information from an internal vehicle bus to an external bus, e.g. the diagnostic connector.
Bus Mirroring.zh: 将信息从车内内部总线转发到外部总线，例如诊断连接器。

Bus Wake-Up.en_definition: A bus wake-up is caused by a specific wake pulse on the bus defined within the specification of the dedicated communication standard (e.g. CAN, LIN, FR). A bus wake-up initiates that the transceiver and controller leave their energy saving mode and enter normal mode to start bus communication again.
Bus Wake-Up.zh: 总线唤醒由专用通信标准（如 CAN、LIN、FR）规范中定义的总线上的特定唤醒脉冲引发。总线唤醒会促使收发器和控制器离开节能模式并进入正常模式，重新开始总线通信。

Bypassing.en_definition: The experimental incorporation of new functionality within an ECU image.
Bypassing.zh: 在 ECU 镜像内以实验方式并入新功能。

Calibration.en_definition: Calibration is the adjustment of parameters of SW-Components realizing the control functionality (namely parameters of AUTOSAR SW-Cs, ECU abstraction or 'Complex Driver'.
Calibration.zh: 标定是对实现控制功能的 SW-C 的参数（即 AUTOSAR SW-C、ECU 抽象或"复杂驱动"（**Complex Driver**）的参数）进行的调整。

Call Point.en_definition: A point in a 'Software Component' where the SW-C enforce an execution entity ('Entry Point') in another SW-C.
Call Point.zh: "软件组件"（**Software Component**）中的一个位置，SW-C 在此强制另一 SW-C 中的执行实体（"入口点"（**Entry Point**））执行。

Callback.en_definition: Functionality that is defined by an AUTOSAR module so that lower-level modules (i.e. lower in the Layered Software Architecture) can provide notification as required (e.g. when certain events occur or asynchronous processing completes).
Callback.zh: 由 AUTOSAR 模块定义的功能，使较低层次的模块（即分层软件架构中较低层的模块）能够在需要时（例如特定事件发生或异步处理完成时）提供通知。

Callout.en_definition: Function stubs that the system designer can replace with code to add functionality to a module which could not be specified by AUTOSAR.
Callout.zh: 一种函数存根，系统设计者可以用代码替换它，从而为模块添加 AUTOSAR 无法规定的功能。

Can XL.en_definition: CAN XL specifies a protocol and physical layer with higher data rate and clearer separation of concerns, that builds on CAN 2.0/FD and features tunneling of Ethernet frames.
Can XL.zh: CAN XL 规定了一种具有更高数据速率和更清晰关注点分离的协议与物理层，它构建在 CAN 2.0/FD 之上，并支持以太网帧的隧道传输。

Cascaded Switch.en_definition: A Cascaded Switch is an Ethernet switch that exists of at least two Ethernet switches: a master switch and a slave switch. The master switch and the slave switch are connected by uplink ports.
Cascaded Switch.zh: 级联交换机（**Cascaded Switch**）是由至少两个以太网交换机组成的以太网交换机：一个主交换机和一个从交换机。主交换机与从交换机通过上行端口连接。

Category 1 Interrupt.en_definition: Category 1 (Cat1) Interrupts are supported by the OS but their code is only allowed to call a very small subset of OS functions. Furthermore they can bypass the OS. The code of Category 1 Interrupts depends (normally) on the used compiler and microcontroller. Category 1 Interrupts are not allowed to use the ISR() macro. Category 1 Interrupts need to implement/establish their own Interrupt Frame. Nevertheless they have to be configured in order to be included in the Interrupt Vector Table.
Category 1 Interrupt.zh: 类别 1（Cat1）中断由 OS 支持，但其代码只允许调用 OS 函数的一个非常小的子集。此外，它们可以绕过 OS。类别 1 中断的代码（通常）取决于所使用的编译器和微控制器。类别 1 中断不允许使用 ISR() 宏。类别 1 中断需要自行实现/建立自己的中断帧（**Interrupt Frame**）。尽管如此，仍必须对它们进行配置，以便将其纳入中断向量表。

Category 2 Interrupt.en_definition: Category 2 (Cat2) Interrupts are supported by the OS and their code can call a subset of OS functions. The definition of the Cat2 Interrupt must use the ISR() macro in order to be recognized by the OS. The Interrupt Frame of a Category 2 Interrupt is managed by the OS.
Category 2 Interrupt.zh: 类别 2（Cat2）中断由 OS 支持，其代码可以调用 OS 函数的一个子集。类别 2 中断的定义必须使用 ISR() 宏，以便被 OS 识别。类别 2 中断的中断帧由 OS 管理。

Causality of Transmission.en_definition: Transmit order of PDUs with the same identifier (instances of PDUs) from a source network is preserved in the destination network.
Causality of Transmission.zh: 来自源网络的、具有相同标识符的 PDU（PDU 实例）的发送顺序在目的网络中得以保持。

Classic Platform.en_definition: Software Platform defined by AUTOSAR for deeply embedded systems and Application Software with high demands regarding predictability, safety and responsivness.
Classic Platform.zh: AUTOSAR 为深度嵌入式系统以及对可预测性、安全性和响应性有高要求的应用软件定义的软件平台。

Client.en_definition: Software entity which uses services of a 'Server'.
Client.zh: 使用"服务器"（**Server**）所提供服务的软件实体。

Client-Server Communication.en_definition: A specific form of communication in a possibly distributed system in which software entities act as Clients, Servers or both, where 1...n clients are requesting services via a specific protocol from typically one server.
Client-Server Communication.zh: 一种可能分布在系统中的特定通信形式，其中软件实体充当客户端、服务器或二者兼有，通常由 1...n 个客户端通过特定协议向一个服务器请求服务。

Client-Server Interface.en_definition: The client-server interface is a special kind of 'Port Interface' used for the case of Client-Server Communication. The client-server interface defines the operations that are provided by the 'Server' and that can be used by the 'Client'.
Client-Server Interface.zh: 客户端-服务器接口是一种特殊的"端口接口"（**Port Interface**），用于客户端-服务器通信的情形。客户端-服务器接口定义了"服务器"（**Server**）提供的、可被"客户端"（**Client**）使用的操作。

Cluster Signal.en_definition: A cluster signal represents the aggregating system signal on one specific communication cluster. Cluster signals can be defined independently of frames. This allows a development methodology where the signals are defined first, and are assigned to frames in a later stage.
Cluster Signal.zh: 簇信号表示某个特定通信簇上的聚合系统信号。簇信号可以独立于帧来定义。这允许一种开发方法论：先定义信号，然后在后续阶段将信号分配到帧。

Code Generator.en_definition: The Code Generator consumes complete and correctly formed XML for a BSW module and generates code and data that configures the module.
Code Generator.zh: 代码生成器（**Code Generator**）接收针对 BSW 模块的完整且格式正确的 XML，并生成配置该模块的代码和数据。

Code Variant Coding.en_definition: Adaptation of SW by selection of functional alternatives according to external requirements
Code Variant Coding.zh: 根据外部需求，通过选择功能备选项来调整软件。

Communication Attribute.en_definition: Communication attributes define, according to the development phase, behavioral as well as implementation aspects of the AUTOSAR communication patterns.
Communication Attribute.zh: 通信属性按照开发阶段定义 AUTOSAR 通信模式的行为与实现两个方面。

Complex Driver.en_definition: A software entity not standardized by AUTOSAR that can access or be accessed via 'AUTOSAR Interface' and/ or 'Basic Software Module' APIs.
Complex Driver.zh: AUTOSAR 未标准化的软件实体，它可以通过"AUTOSAR 接口"（**AUTOSAR Interface**）和/或"基础软件模块"（**Basic Software Module**）API 访问其他实体或被其他实体访问。

Composition.en_definition: An AUTOSAR Composition encapsulates a collaboration of Software Components ('Software Component'), thereby hiding detail and allowing the creation of higher abstraction levels. Through Delegation Connectors ('Connector') a Composition explicitly specifies, which Ports ('Port') of the internal components are visible from the outside. AUTOSAR Compositions are a type of Components, e.g. they can be part of further compositions.
Composition.zh: AUTOSAR 组合（**Composition**）封装了软件组件（**Software Component**）之间的协作，从而隐藏细节并允许创建更高的抽象层级。通过委托连接器（**Connector**），组合显式地规定内部组件的哪些"端口"（**Port**）从外部可见。AUTOSAR 组合是组件的一种类型，例如它们可以成为更高层组合的一部分。

Compositionality.en_definition: Compositionality is given when the behavior of a software component or subsystem of a system is independent of the overall system load and configuration.
Compositionality.zh: 当系统中某个软件组件或子系统的行为与整个系统的负载和配置无关时，即具有可组合性（**Compositionality**）。

Conditioned Signal.en_definition: The conditioned signal is the internal electrical representation of the electrical signal within the ECU. It is delivered to the processor and represented in voltage and time (or, in case of logical signals, by high or low level).
Conditioned Signal.zh: 处理后的信号（**Conditioned Signal**）是电信号在 ECU 内部的电气表示。它被传送给处理器，并以电压和时间表示（对于逻辑信号则以高电平或低电平表示）。

Confidentiality.en_definition: The property that data or information is not made available or disclosed to unauthorized persons or processes.
Confidentiality.zh: 数据或信息不向未授权的人员或进程提供或泄露的特性。

Configuration.en_definition: The arrangement of hardware and/or software elements in a system.
Configuration.zh: 系统中硬件和/或软件元素的布置。

Confirmation.en_definition: Service primitive defined in the ISO/OSI Reference model ([17]). With the 'confirmation' service primitive a service provider informs a service user about the result of a preceding service request of the service user.
Confirmation.zh: ISO/OSI 参考模型（[17]）中定义的服务原语。通过"确认"（**confirmation**）服务原语，服务提供者就服务用户先前的服务请求的结果通知该服务用户。

Connector.en_definition: A connector connects Ports ('Port') of Software Components ('Software Component') and represents the flow of information between those ports.
Connector.zh: 连接器（**Connector**）连接软件组件（**Software Component**）的"端口"（**Port**），并表示这些端口之间的信息流。

Control Flow.en_definition: The directed transmission of information between multiple entities, directly resulting in a state change of the receiving entity.
Control Flow.zh: 多个实体之间信息的定向传输，直接导致接收实体的状态改变。

Coordinate.en_definition: To control and harmonize two or more events or operations to act in an organized and predictable way.
Coordinate.zh: 控制并协调两个或多个事件或操作，使其以有组织、可预测的方式运行。

Data.en_definition: A reinterpretable representation of information in a formalized manner suitable for communication, interpretation or processing.
Data.zh: 以适合通信、解释或处理的形式化方式对信息的可重新解释的表示。

Data Element.en_definition: Data elements are declared within the context of a 'Sender-Receiver Interface'. They serve as the data units that are exchanged between sender and receiver.
Data Element.zh: 数据元素（**Data Element**）在"发送方-接收方接口"（**Sender-Receiver Interface**）的上下文中声明。它们用作发送方与接收方之间交换的数据单元。

Data Flow.en_definition: The directed transmission of Data between multiple entities. The transmissioned data are not directly related to a state change at the receiver side.
Data Flow.zh: 多个实体之间数据的定向传输。所传输的数据与接收方的状态改变没有直接关系。

Data Variant Coding.en_definition: Adaptation of SW by setup of certain characteristic data according to external requirements.
Data Variant Coding.zh: 根据外部需求，通过设置某些特征数据来调整软件。

Deadline.en_definition: The point in time when an execution of an entity must be finished.
Deadline.zh: 实体的某次执行必须结束的时间点。

Debugging.en_definition: Debugging is the process of gathering information in case of a software problem. The information is used to analyze the software problem.
Debugging.zh: 调试是在出现软件问题时收集信息的过程。所收集的信息用于分析该软件问题。

Dependability.en_definition: Dependability is defined as the trustworthiness of a computer system such that reliance can justifiable be placed on the service it delivers.
Dependability.zh: 可信性（**Dependability**）定义为计算机系统的可信程度，使得对其所交付服务的依赖是正当合理的。

Diagnostic Event.en_definition: A diagnostic event defines the atomic unit that can be handled by the DEM module. The status of a diagnostic event represents the result of a monitor. The DEM receives the result of a monitor from SW-C via the RTE or other BSW modules.
Diagnostic Event.zh: 诊断事件（**Diagnostic Event**）定义了可由 DEM 模块处理的最小单元。诊断事件的状态表示某个监控器的结果。DEM 通过 RTE 或其他 BSW 模块从 SW-C 接收监控器的结果。

Dynamic PDU.zh: 具有动态标识符的"协议数据单元"（**Protocol Data Unit**）。

Dynamic Routing.en_definition: The routing of signals or Protocol Data Units ('Protocol Data Unit') in a gateway can be changed throughout operation without change of the operation mode of the gateway.
Dynamic Routing.zh: 网关中信号或"协议数据单元"（**Protocol Data Unit**）的路由可以在整个运行期间改变，而无需改变网关的运行模式。

E2E Profile.en_definition: A functional and complete description of a specific communication stack in terms of data structures, services, behavioral state-machines, error handling. E2E Profiles are defined in AUTOSAR E2E Library. An E2E Profile is configurable by runtime parameters. A specific set of runtime parameters is called E2E profile variant. In order to reach interoperability, the application developers should use the E2E profile variants defined in the E2E library.
E2E Profile.zh: 对特定通信栈在数据结构、服务、行为状态机、错误处理方面的功能完整描述。E2E Profile 定义在 AUTOSAR E2E 库中。E2E Profile 可通过运行时参数配置。一组特定的运行时参数称为 E2E profile 变体（**E2E profile variant**）。为了实现互操作性，应用开发者应使用 E2E 库中定义的 E2E profile 变体。

E2E Protection Alive Counter.en_definition: An Alive Counter is a counter which is incremented in every transmission request. The counter value is checked at the receiver side, whether it changes at all, but not if the counter was incremented correctly.
E2E Protection Alive Counter.zh: 存活计数器（**Alive Counter**）是每次发送请求时递增的计数器。接收方检查计数值是否发生变化，但不检查计数器是否被正确递增。

E2E Protection Sequence Counter.en_definition: A Sequence Counter is a counter which is incremented in every transmission request. The value of the counter value is checked at the receiver side for each message, whether it was incremented correctly.
E2E Protection Sequence Counter.zh: 序列计数器（**Sequence Counter**）是每次发送请求时递增的计数器。接收方对每条报文检查计数值是否被正确递增。

ECU Abstraction Layer.en_definition: The ECU Abstraction Layer is located above the 'Microcontroller Abstraction Layer' and abstracts from the ECU schematic. It is implemented for a specific ECU and offers an API for access to peripherals and devices regardless of their location (onchip/offchip) and their connection to the microcontroller (port pins, type of interface). Task: Make higher software layers independent of the ECU hardware layout.
ECU Abstraction Layer.zh: ECU 抽象层（**ECU Abstraction Layer**）位于"微控制器抽象层"（**Microcontroller Abstraction Layer**）之上，对 ECU 原理图进行抽象。它为特定 ECU 实现，并提供访问外设和设备的 API，而无论其位置（片上/片下）及其与微控制器的连接方式（端口引脚、接口类型）如何。任务：使较高的软件层次独立于 ECU 硬件布局。

ECU Configuration.en_definition: Activity of integrating and configuring one ECU's software.
ECU Configuration.zh: 集成并配置一个 ECU 软件的活动。

ECU Configuration Description.en_definition: Output of the ECU Configuration activity containing the values of configuration parameters and references.
ECU Configuration Description.zh: ECU 配置活动的输出，包含配置参数的取值和引用。

ECU HW.en_definition: A container term for any combination of AP Machines and CP ECUs. In general terms, an ECU-HW is typically abstracted/independent from physical or virtual realization and does not convey any HW-Housing i.e. multiple physical ECU-HWs or a physical ECU-HW providing multiple virtual ECU-HWs (unless otherwise stated).
ECU HW.zh: AP 机器与 CP ECU 的任意组合的容器术语。一般来说，ECU-HW 通常是对物理或虚拟实现的抽象/独立于物理或虚拟实现，并且不传递任何硬件壳体（**HW-Housing**）信息，即多个物理 ECU-HW 或一个物理 ECU-HW 提供多个虚拟 ECU-HW（除非另有说明）。

ECU Instance.en_definition: An ECU Instance represents a single instantiation of a Classic Platform stack, that may run on physical ECU-HW (without hypervisor) or on virtual ECU-HW (with hypervisor).
ECU Instance.zh: ECU 实例（**ECU Instance**）表示经典平台协议栈的一次单独实例化，它可以运行在物理 ECU-HW 上（无 hypervisor）或虚拟 ECU-HW 上（有 hypervisor）。

Electrical Signal.en_definition: The electrical signal is the electrical representation of Technical Signals ('Technical Signal'). Electrical signals can only be represented in voltage, current and time
Electrical Signal.zh: 电信号（**Electrical Signal**）是"技术信号"（**Technical Signal**）的电气表示。电信号只能以电压、电流和时间表示。

Electronic Control Unit.en_definition: Embedded computer system consisting of at least one CPU and corresponding peripherals which are placed in one housing.
Electronic Control Unit.zh: 由至少一个 CPU 和相应外设组成、置于同一壳体内的嵌入式计算机系统。

Empty Function.en_definition: Any C function defined by an AUTOSAR specification which does not implement or alter behavior required to accomplish the assigned functional responsibility.
Empty Function.zh: 由 AUTOSAR 规范定义、但不实现或不改变完成其被指派的功能职责所需行为的任何 C 函数。

Entry Point.en_definition: A point in a 'Software Component' where an execution entity of the SW-C begins.
Entry Point.zh: "软件组件"（**Software Component**）中 SW-C 的某个执行实体开始的位置。

Error Detection Rate.en_definition: Ratio between detected lost/faulty words/symbols/blocks, divided by the total number of symbols/ words/blocks sent.
Error Detection Rate.zh: 检测到的丢失/故障字/符号/块的数量除以已发送的符号/字/块总数的比值。

Ethernet Switch Port Groups.en_definition: Ethernet Switch Port groups are Ethernet switch ports of an Ethernet switch which are grouped to so called port groups. Ethernet Switch Port groups are only relevant for the host ECU. Ethernet Switch Port Groups are derived from the model per VLAN and per PNC. The host port is participating in all port groups. A Ethernet Switch Port Group could be a mix of internal and external ports.
Ethernet Switch Port Groups.zh: 以太网交换机端口组（**Ethernet Switch Port Groups**）是以太网交换机中被分组为所谓端口组的以太网交换机端口。以太网交换机端口组只与宿主 ECU（**host ECU**）相关。以太网交换机端口组按 VLAN 和 PNC 从模型中派生。宿主端口参与所有端口组。一个以太网交换机端口组可以是内部端口和外部端口的混合。

Event.en_definition: State change of a hardware and/or software entity.
Event.zh: 硬件和/或软件实体的状态改变。

Event Message (SOME/IP).en_definition: Event - a message sent by an ECU implementing a service instance to an ECU using this service instance (Publish/Subscribe).
Event Message (SOME/IP).zh: 事件（**Event**）——由实现某服务实例的 ECU 发送给使用该服务实例的 ECU 的报文（发布/订阅）。

Executable.en_definition: Part of an application which consists of either a file containing executable code with a defined entry point and suitable for the platform instance as the target of deployment (deployment time) or software code which is ready to be integrated for a specific platform.
Executable.zh: 应用的一部分，它要么是包含带已定义入口点的可执行代码、适合作为部署目标平台实例的文件（部署期），要么是已准备好为特定平台集成的软件代码。

Executable Entity Cluster.en_definition: A set of Executable Entities (EEs) and a reference to a set of Execution Order Constraints (EOCs) between these EEs. The Executable Entity Cluster is formed for the purpose of mapping EEs to LET intervals and to tasks. Several EECs may be mapped to the same LET interval.
Executable Entity Cluster.zh: 一组可执行实体（**Executable Entity**, EE）以及这些 EE 之间的一组执行顺序约束（**Execution Order Constraint**, EOC）的引用。构建可执行实体簇（**Executable Entity Cluster**, EEC）的目的是将 EE 映射到 LET 区间和任务。多个 EEC 可以映射到同一个 LET 区间。

Execution Order Constraint.en_definition: Defines the execution order between instances of Executable Entities (EEs) within the same LET interval.
Execution Order Constraint.zh: 定义同一 LET 区间内可执行实体（**Executable Entity**, EE）实例之间的执行顺序。

Execution Time.en_definition: The time during which a program is actually executing, or more precisely during which a certain thread of execution is active.
Execution Time.zh: 程序实际执行所经历的时间，或更精确地说，某个执行线程处于活动状态的时间。

Exit Point.en_definition: A point in a 'Software Component' where an execution entity of the SW-C ends.
Exit Point.zh: "软件组件"（**Software Component**）中 SW-C 的某个执行实体结束的位置。

External Port.en_definition: External Ports are ports of an automotive Ethernet switch used to communicate over an Ethernet physical connection with other ECUs (e.g. 100BASE-TX, 100BASE-T1).
External Port.zh: 外部端口（**External Port**）是汽车以太网交换机上用于通过以太网物理连接与其他 ECU 通信（例如 100BASE-TX、100BASE-T1）的端口。

Fail-operational.en_definition: Property of a system or functional unit. Describes the ability of a system or functional unit to continue normal operation at its output interfaces despite the presence of hardware or software faults.
Fail-operational.zh: 系统或功能单元的一种属性。描述系统或功能单元在存在硬件或软件故障的情况下，仍能在其输出接口上继续正常运行的能力。

Fail-safe.en_definition: Property of a system or functional unit. In case of a fault the system or functional unit transits to a safe state.
Fail-safe.zh: 系统或功能单元的一种属性。在发生故障时，系统或功能单元转入安全状态。

Fail-silent.en_definition: Fail-silent is a property of a system in which no output is produced in the presence of a fault. In automotive domain, fail-silent systems are usually only used if the next hierarchical system level provides a safe-state.
Fail-silent.zh: 失效静默（**Fail-silent**）是系统的一种属性，即在存在故障时不产生任何输出。在汽车领域，失效静默系统通常只在下一个层级系统提供安全状态时才被使用。

Fault Detection.en_definition: The action of monitoring errors and setting fault states to specific values is called fault detection.
Fault Detection.zh: 监控错误并将故障状态设置为特定值的动作称为故障检测。

Fault Reaction.en_definition: In case of a Failure of a SW-C there is a specific action to be carried out. This action is called "Fault Reaction".
Fault Reaction.zh: 在 SW-C 发生失效（**Failure**）时，有一个需要执行的特定动作。该动作称为"故障反应"（**Fault Reaction**）。

Fault Tolerance.en_definition: Ability to deliver the specified functionality in the presence of one or more specified faults.
Fault Tolerance.zh: 在存在一个或多个规定故障的情况下交付规定功能的能力。

Feature.en_definition: A Feature is a notable characteristic of a system.
Feature.zh: 特性（**Feature**）是系统的一个显著特征。

Firewall.en_definition: Functional element that inspects and filters network traffic based on firewall rules.
Firewall.zh: 基于防火墙规则检查并过滤网络流量的功能元素。

Flag.en_definition: A piece of data that can take on one of two values indicating whether a logical condition is true or false.
Flag.zh: 一种数据，可以取两个值之一，用于指示某个逻辑条件为真还是为假。

FlexRay.en_definition: Automotive time-triggered and fault-tolerant network communication protocol that is standardized in the ISO 17458 ([29]) and provides options for deterministic data that arrives in a predictable time frame as well as dynamic event-driven data.
FlexRay.zh: 在 ISO 17458（[29]）中标准化的汽车时间触发、容错网络通信协议，它既提供在可预测时间范围内到达的确定性数据，也支持动态的事件驱动数据。

Foundation.en_definition: Foundation contains the generic artifacts that are common for Adaptive Platform and Classic Platform to ensure compatibility between: • Classic- and Adaptive Platform • Non-AUTOSAR platforms to AUTOSAR platforms In AUTOSAR the particular realization of those generic artifacts is described in Adaptive Platform and Classic Platform and may differ.
Foundation.zh: Foundation 包含自适应平台与经典平台通用的制品，以确保以下二者之间的兼容性：• 经典平台与自适应平台 • 非 AUTOSAR 平台与 AUTOSAR 平台。在 AUTOSAR 中，这些通用制品的具体实现分别在自适应平台和经典平台中描述，并且可能不同。

Frame.en_definition: Data unit according to the data link protocol specifying the arrangement and meaning of bits or bit fields in the sequence of transfer across the transfer medium.
Frame.zh: 按照数据链路协议规定在传输介质上传输序列中位或位域的排列与含义的数据单元。

Frame PDU.en_definition: A PDU that fits into 1 frame instance e.g. it does not need to be fragmented across more than 1 frame for transmission over a network.
Frame PDU.zh: 能放入 1 个帧实例的 PDU，例如在网络上传输时不需要跨多个帧分段。

Freshness.en_definition: Data Freshness implies that the data is recent and it ensures that replayed messages in a replay attack are detected.
Freshness.zh: 数据新鲜度（**Freshness**）意味着数据是最近的，它确保重放攻击中被重放的报文能够被检测出来。

Function.en_definition: 1. A task, action or activity that must be accomplished to achieve a desired outcome. 2. A part of programming code that is invoked by other parts of the program to fulfill a desired purpose. 3. In mathematics, a function is an association between two sets of values in which each element of one set has one assigned element in the other set so that any element selected becomes the independent variable and its associated element is the dependent variable.
Function.zh: 1. 为达到期望结果而必须完成的任务、动作或活动。2. 由程序的其他部分为达到期望目的而调用的程序代码的一部分。3. 在数学中，函数是两组值之间的关联，其中一组的每个元素在另一组中有一个被指派的对应元素，于是从该组中选出的任何元素成为自变量，其关联元素成为因变量。

Functional Cluster.en_definition: Set of requirements grouped by the aspect they refer to.
Functional Cluster.zh: 按照其所指的方面分组的一组需求。

Functional Network.en_definition: A logical structure of interconnections between defined functional parts of Features.
Functional Network.zh: 特性（**Feature**）的已定义功能部分之间互连的一种逻辑结构。

Functional Unit.en_definition: An entity of software or hardware, or both, capable of accomplishing a specified purpose.
Functional Unit.zh: 能够完成特定目的的软件或硬件实体，或二者的结合。

Functionality.en_definition: Functionality comprises User-visible and User-non-visible functional aspects of a system.
Functionality.zh: 功能性（**Functionality**）包含系统对用户可见和不可见的功能方面。

Gateway.en_definition: A gateway is functionality within a Classic Platform ECU that performs a frame or signal mapping function between two communication systems. Communication system in this context means e.g. a CAN system or one channel of a FlexRay system.
Gateway.zh: 网关（**Gateway**）是经典平台 ECU 内的一种功能，它在两个通信系统之间执行帧或信号映射功能。这里的通信系统例如指 CAN 系统或 FlexRay 系统的一个通道。

Gateway ECU.en_definition: A gateway ECU is an 'Electronic Control Unit' that is connected to two or more communication channels, and performs gateway functionality.
Gateway ECU.zh: 网关 ECU（**Gateway ECU**）是连接到两个或多个通信信道并执行网关功能的"电子控制单元"（**Electronic Control Unit**）。

Graceful Degradation.en_definition: Graceful Degradation: The system continues to operate in the presence of errors, accepting a partial degradation of functionality or performance during recovery or repair. Found in the literature also as "fail soft".
Graceful Degradation.zh: 优雅降级（**Graceful Degradation**）：系统在存在错误的情况下继续运行，在恢复或修理期间接受功能或性能的部分降级。文献中也称为"fail soft"。

Hardware Abstraction Layer.en_definition: A hardware abstraction layer is a software layer that serves as an abstraction layer between the physical hardware and its software. It allows to access the hardware resources through programming interfaces.
Hardware Abstraction Layer.zh: 硬件抽象层（**Hardware Abstraction Layer**）是介于物理硬件与其软件之间的抽象层软件。它允许通过编程接口访问硬件资源。

Hardware Connection.en_definition: HW Connections are used to describe the connection of Hardware Elements ('Hardware Element') among each other. It defines/characterizes the interrelationship among HW Elements (for abstract modeling). The Hardware Ports ('Hardware Port') of HW Elements serve as connection points for this purpose.
Hardware Connection.zh: 硬件连接（**HW Connection**）用于描述硬件元素（**Hardware Element**）彼此之间的连接。它定义/刻画硬件元素之间的相互关系（用于抽象建模）。硬件元素的"硬件端口"（**Hardware Port**）充当连接点。

Hardware Element.en_definition: The HW Element is the main describing element of an 'Electronic Control Unit'. It provides Hardware Ports ('Hardware Port') for being interconnected among each others. A generic HW Element specifies definitions valid for all specific HW Elements.
Hardware Element.zh: 硬件元素（**HW Element**）是"电子控制单元"（**Electronic Control Unit**）的主要描述元素。它提供硬件端口（**Hardware Port**）以便彼此互连。通用硬件元素规定对所有特定硬件元素有效的定义。

Hardware Interrupt.zh: 由硬件事件触发的中断。

Hardware Port.en_definition: The HW port exposes functionality to the exterior of the 'Hardware Element'. HW elements can be connected via 'Hardware Connection'. It defines a connection Endpoint for the HW Element.
Hardware Port.zh: 硬件端口（**HW port**）向"硬件元素"（**Hardware Element**）的外部暴露功能。硬件元素可以通过"硬件连接"（**Hardware Connection**）互连。它为硬件元素定义一个连接端点。

Health Indicator.en_definition: Health Indicators (HIs) are an evaluation metric of current system performance with regard to safety requirement
Health Indicator.zh: 健康指示器（**Health Indicators**, HI）是针对安全需求的当前系统性能的评估度量。

Hook.en_definition: An intervention point within ECU software for the exchange of data.
Hook.zh: ECU 软件中用于交换数据的干预点。

Host ECU.en_definition: A Host ECU is a ECU that controls one or more automotive Ethernet switches (e.g. switch on / off the Ethernet switch and its ports, read and write the Ethernet switch configuration). For this purpose the host ECU is connected to the Ethernet switch over a common control interface (e.g. SPI, MDIO). The host ecu also take part in the network communication. For this purpose the host ecu is connected by a data interface (e.g. MII) to a specific Ethernet switch port (host port).It transmits and receives Ethernet frames.
Host ECU.zh: 宿主 ECU（**Host ECU**）是控制一个或多个汽车以太网交换机的 ECU（例如打开/关闭以太网交换机及其端口，读/写以太网交换机配置）。为此，宿主 ECU 通过公共控制接口（如 SPI、MDIO）连接到以太网交换机。宿主 ECU 也参与网络通信。为此，宿主 ECU 通过数据接口（如 MII）连接到特定的以太网交换机端口（宿主端口）。它发送和接收以太网帧。

Host Port.en_definition: A host port is a port of an automotive Ethernet switch where the data interface (e.g. MII) of the 'Host ECU' is connected to. The host port could either be an internal port or an external port. The host port has a special role from the perspective of the software. (see link accumulation and port groups)
Host Port.zh: 宿主端口（**host port**）是汽车以太网交换机上连接"宿主 ECU"（**Host ECU**）数据接口（如 MII）的端口。宿主端口可以是内部端口或外部端口。从软件的角度看，宿主端口具有特殊角色（参见链路汇聚和端口组）。

Hypervisor.en_definition: Low-level software that provides and manages several virtual machines in one physical machine. Maybe an independent software or contained as an OS functionality.
Hypervisor.zh: 在一台物理机中提供并管理多台虚拟机的底层软件。它可以是独立的软件，也可以作为 OS 的功能包含在内。

Identity and Access Management (IAM).en_definition: IAM is about managing access rights of Adaptive Applications to interfaces of the Adaptive Platform Foundation and Services.
Identity and Access Management (IAM).zh: IAM（身份与访问管理）是关于管理自适应应用对自适应平台基础与服务的接口的访问权限。

Identity Information.en_definition: The access control is decided / enforced upon the identity information which represents properties of the Adaptive Applications.
Identity Information.zh: 访问控制基于代表自适应应用属性的身份信息（**Identity Information**）来决策/执行。

Implementation Conformance Class 1 (ICC1.en_definition: An ICC1 cluster offers a 'Software Component Interface' and/or 'Network Interface'. The 'Software Component Interface' and 'Network Interface' of an ICC1 cluster provide the functional behavior as specified in the AUTOSAR specifications on ICC3 level.
Implementation Conformance Class 1 (ICC1.zh: ICC1 集群提供"软件组件接口"（**Software Component Interface**）和/或"网络接口"（**Network Interface**）。ICC1 集群的软件组件接口和网络接口提供 AUTOSAR 规范在 ICC3 级别所规定的功能行为。

Implementation Conformance Class 2 (ICC2.en_definition: ICC2 clusters logically related ICC3 Basic Software (BSW) modules (2...N modules). The number of Cluster Features in an ICC2 cluster is a subset of the union of the number of features of the clustered ICC3 modules.
Implementation Conformance Class 2 (ICC2.zh: ICC2 集群将逻辑相关的 ICC3 基础软件（**BSW**）模块（2...N 个模块）组合在一起。ICC2 集群中集群特性（**Cluster Feature**）的数量是被集群的 ICC3 模块特性数量并集的子集。

Implementation Conformance Class 3 (ICC3.en_definition: For ICC3 the AUTOSAR BSW consists of BSW modules as defined in the Basic Software Module List, including the RTE. ICC3 is the highest level of granularity.
Implementation Conformance Class 3 (ICC3.zh: 对于 ICC3，AUTOSAR BSW 由基础软件模块列表中定义的 BSW 模块组成，包括 RTE。ICC3 是最高级别的粒度。

Indication.en_definition: Service primitive defined in the ISO/OSI Reference Model ([17]). With the service primitive 'indication' a service provider informs a service user about the occurrence of either an internal event or a service request issued by another service user.
Indication.zh: ISO/OSI 参考模型（[17]）中定义的服务原语。通过"指示"（**indication**）服务原语，服务提供者就内部事件的发生或另一服务用户发出的服务请求通知某服务用户。

Integration.en_definition: The progressive assembling of system components into the whole system.
Integration.zh: 将系统组件逐步组装成整个系统。

Integration Code.en_definition: Code that the Integrator needs to add to an AUTOSAR System, to adapt non-standardized functionalities. Examples are Callouts ('Callout') of the ECU State Manager and Callbacks ('Callback') of various other Basic Software Modules.
Integration Code.zh: 集成者需要添加到 AUTOSAR 系统中以适配未标准化功能的代码。例如 ECU 状态管理器（**EcuM**）的 Callout（**Callout**）以及各种其他基础软件模块的回调（**Callback**）。

Integrity.en_definition: The property that data or information have not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.
Integrity.zh: 数据或信息未以未授权方式被更改或销毁的特性。

Integrity Check Value.en_definition: The result of a cryptographic function used to ensure that unauthorized modifications of a message are detected.
Integrity Check Value.zh: 用于确保未授权的消息修改能够被检测到的密码学函数的结果。

Interface.en_definition: A shared boundary between two Functional Units ('Functional Unit') defined by various characteristics pertaining to the functions, physical interconnections, signal exchanges, and other characteristics, as appropriate.
Interface.zh: 两个功能单元（**Functional Unit**）之间的共享边界，由涉及功能、物理互连、信号交换及其他特性的各种特征（视情况而定）定义。

Intermediate PNC Coordinator.en_definition: An intermediate PNC (Partial Network Cluster) coordinator is located beneath a 'Top-level PNC Coordinator' or a further intermediate PNC coordinator and above a PNC leaf nodes ('PNC Leaf Node') or a further intermediate PNC coordinator within a PNC network. The intermediate PNC coordinator forwards received PNC requests and own PNC requests to its 'Top-level PNC Coordinator'. An intermediate PNC coordinator processes a received PN shutdown message immediately, forwards it to its subordinated ECUs (either a further intermediate PNC coordinator or a PNC leaf nodes), releases the indicated PNCs and resets the PN reset timer(s) for those PNCs.
Intermediate PNC Coordinator.zh: 中间 PNC 协调器（**Intermediate PNC Coordinator**）在 PNC 网络中位于"顶层 PNC 协调器"（**Top-level PNC Coordinator**）或另一个中间 PNC 协调器之下、PNC 叶节点（**PNC Leaf Node**）或另一个中间 PNC 协调器之上。中间 PNC 协调器将收到的 PNC 请求和自己的 PNC 请求转发给其"顶层 PNC 协调器"。中间 PNC 协调器立即处理收到的 PN 关机报文，将其转发给其下级 ECU（另一个中间 PNC 协调器或 PNC 叶节点），释放所指示的 PNC 并为这些 PNC 重置 PN 复位定时器。

Internal Port.en_definition: Internal Ports are ports of an automotive Ethernet switch used for local communication (Host ECU or cascaded switch)
Internal Port.zh: 内部端口（**Internal Port**）是汽车以太网交换机上用于本地通信（宿主 ECU 或级联交换机）的端口。

Interrupt Frames.en_definition: An interrupt frame is the code which handles the entering/leaving of (C written) interrupt service routines. This code is microcontroller specific and often written in assembly language. Interrupt frames are typically generated by the OS generation tool.
Interrupt Frames.zh: 中断帧（**Interrupt Frame**）是处理进入/离开（用 C 编写的）中断服务程序的代码。这段代码与微控制器相关，通常用汇编语言编写。中断帧通常由 OS 生成工具生成。

Interrupt Handler.en_definition: In the case of a Category 2 interrupt, the ISR is synonymous with Interrupt Handler. In the case of Category 1 interrupt the Interrupt Handler is the function called by the hardware interrupt vector. In both cases the Interrupt handler is the user code that is normally a part of the BSW module. So the Interrupt Handler is a user level piece of code.
Interrupt Handler.zh: 对于类别 2 中断，ISR 与中断处理程序（**Interrupt Handler**）同义。对于类别 1 中断，中断处理程序是由硬件中断向量调用的函数。在这两种情况下，中断处理程序都是用户代码，通常是 BSW 模块的一部分。因此中断处理程序是用户级的一段代码。

Interrupt Service Routine.en_definition: A software routine called in case of an 'Interrupt'.
Interrupt Service Routine.zh: 在发生"中断"（**Interrupt**）时被调用的软件例程。

Interrupt Vector Table.en_definition: An interrupt vector table is a table of interrupt vectors that associates the Interrupt Service Routine with the corresponding interrupt request (typically by an array of jumps or similar mechanisms).
Interrupt Vector Table.zh: 中断向量表（**Interrupt Vector Table**）是一张中断向量表，它将中断服务程序与相应的中断请求关联起来（通常通过跳转数组或类似机制）。

Interrupt.en_definition: Event that enforces the processor to change its state. This interruption causes the normal sequence of instructions to be stopped. Once an interrupt occurred, the running software entity is suspended and an 'Interrupt Service Routine' (the one dedicated to this interrupt) is called.
Interrupt.zh: 强制处理器改变其状态的事件。这种中断导致正常的指令序列被停止。一旦发生中断，正在运行的软件实体被挂起，并调用一个"中断服务程序"（**Interrupt Service Routine**）（专用于该中断的那一个）。

Intrusion Detection System.en_definition: A system that is responsible for detecting, recording and reporting security events.
Intrusion Detection System.zh: 负责检测、记录和报告安全事件的系统。

Invalid Flag.en_definition: For a signal in a PDU an optional invalid flag can be added to the PDU payload layout. This flag indicates the validity of other signals in the payload. In case the invalid flag of a signal is set to true in a PDU instance, the respective signal in the payload of the PDU instance does not contain a valid signal value.
Invalid Flag.zh: 对于 PDU 中的信号，可以在 PDU 有效载荷布局中添加一个可选的无效标志（**Invalid Flag**）。该标志指示有效载荷中其他信号的有效性。当某个信号的无效标志在 PDU 实例中被置为 true 时，该 PDU 实例有效载荷中的相应信号不包含有效的信号值。

Invalid Value of Signal.en_definition: For a signal in a PDU an optional invalid value can be defined.
Invalid Value of Signal.zh: 对于 PDU 中的信号，可以定义一个可选的无效值（**Invalid Value**）。

I-PDU.en_definition: Interaction Layer Protocol Data Unit Collection of messages for transfer between nodes in a network. At the sending node the Interaction Layer (IL) is responsible for packing messages into an I-PDU and then sending it to the Data Link Layer (DLL) for transmission. At the receiving node the DLL passes each I-PDU to the IL which then unpacks the messages sending their contents to the application.
I-PDU.zh: 交互层协议数据单元（**I-PDU**）：在网络中节点之间传输的报文集合。在发送节点，交互层（**Interaction Layer**, IL）负责将报文打包为 I-PDU，然后将其发送到数据链路层（**Data Link Layer**, DLL）进行传输。在接收节点，DLL 将每个 I-PDU 传给 IL，IL 随后解包报文并将其内容发送给应用。

Life Cycle.en_definition: The course of development/evolutionary stages of a model element during its life time.
Life Cycle.zh: 模型元素在其生存期内的发展/演化阶段历程。

LIN Bus Idle.en_definition: Bus Idle is defined as no transition between recessive and dominant bit values on the LIN bus.
LIN Bus Idle.zh: 总线空闲（**Bus Idle**）定义为 LIN 总线上隐性位与显性位值之间没有跳变的状态。

Link State Accumulation.en_definition: The link state of a certain switch port group is accumulated by embracing the link state of each port that is part of the port group. The rule how to embracing the link state is specified in the Ethernet Interface.
Link State Accumulation.zh: 通过汇总端口组中每个端口的链路状态来累积某个交换机端口组的链路状态。汇总链路状态的规则在以太网接口（**Ethernet Interface**）中规定。

Link Time Configuration.en_definition: The configuration of the SW module is done until link time.
Link Time Configuration.zh: SW 模块的配置在链接期之前完成。

Logical Execution Time.en_definition: Is a fixed time interval. Input data is read at the beginning of this interval and output data is written at the end of the interval. Processing of the data is limited within the time interval.
Logical Execution Time.zh: 是一个固定的时间区间。输入数据在该区间的开始处读取，输出数据在该区间的结束处写出。数据的处理被限制在该时间区间内。

Log and Trace.en_definition: Log and Trace provides interfaces for applications to forward logging and tracing information onto the communication bus, the console, or to the file system.
Log and Trace.zh: 日志与跟踪（**Log and Trace**）为应用提供接口，用于将日志和跟踪信息转发到通信总线、控制台或文件系统。

Logging.en_definition: Logging is the activity of collecting information about arbitrary, not necessarily correlated events within a system during runtime.
Logging.zh: 日志记录（**Logging**）是在运行期间收集系统中任意的、不必然相关的事件信息的活动。

Machine.en_definition: A Machine is a single instantiation of an Adaptive Platform stack, that may run on physical ECU-HW (without hypervisor) or on virtual ECU-HW (with hypervisor).
Machine.zh: 机器（**Machine**）是自适应平台协议栈的一次单独实例化，它可以运行在物理 ECU-HW 上（无 hypervisor）或虚拟 ECU-HW 上（有 hypervisor）。

Manifest.en_definition: A Manifest represents a piece of AUTOSAR model description that is created to support the configuration of an AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform product and which is uploaded to the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform product, potentially in combination with other artifacts (like binary files) that contain executable code to which the Manifest applies.
Manifest.zh: 清单（**Manifest**）表示为支持 AUTOSAR 自适应平台产品的配置而创建的一段 AUTOSAR 模型描述，它被上传到 AUTOSAR 自适应平台产品，可能与其他包含清单所适用可执行代码的制品（如二进制文件）一起上传。

Mappable Element.en_definition: A mappable element is a part of a MCAL module which can be assigned to a partition via a reference parameter in the Base Software Module Description of the module. Mappable elements allow the formal description on how MCAL modules are available respectively- distributed on partitions (and thus cores).
Mappable Element.zh: 可映射元素（**Mappable Element**）是 MCAL 模块的一部分，可以通过该模块基础软件模块描述中的引用参数将其分配到某个分区。可映射元素允许以形式化方式描述 MCAL 模块在分区（以及核）上的可用性/分布方式。

Mapping.en_definition: Mapping designates the distribution of elements in the logical view to elements in the physical view.
Mapping.zh: 映射（**Mapping**）指定逻辑视图中的元素到物理视图中的元素的分布。

Master Switch.en_definition: A Master Switch is an Ethernet switch where the host port is located.
Master Switch.zh: 主交换机（**Master Switch**）是宿主端口所在的以太网交换机。

MCAL Signal.en_definition: The MCAL signal is the software representation of the 'Conditioned Signal'. It is provided by the microcontroller abstraction layer (MCAL) and is further processed by the ECU abstraction.
MCAL Signal.zh: MCAL 信号（**MCAL Signal**）是"处理后的信号"（**Conditioned Signal**）的软件表示。它由微控制器抽象层（**MCAL**）提供，并由 ECU 抽象进一步处理。

Meta-data.zh: 元数据（**Meta-data**）是关于数据的数据。

MetaDataItem.en_definition: Defined item of Meta-data for a 'Protocol Data Unit' e.g. a diagnostic address, a MAC address, a CAN ID, or a J1939 node address.
MetaDataItem.zh: 为"协议数据单元"（**Protocol Data Unit**）定义的元数据项，例如诊断地址、MAC 地址、CAN ID 或 J1939 节点地址。

Microcontroller.en_definition: Hardware element that integrates computing and communication resources as well as peripheral circuits in a single chip, including memories.
Microcontroller.zh: 在单个芯片（包括存储器）中集成计算与通信资源以及外围电路的硬件元素。

Microcontroller Abstraction Layer.en_definition: Software layer containing drivers to enable the access of onchip peripheral devices of a microcontroller and offchip memory mapped peripheral devices by a defined 'Application Programming Interface'. Task: make higher software layers independent of the microcontroller.
Microcontroller Abstraction Layer.zh: 包含各类驱动程序的软件层，通过已定义的"应用编程接口"（**Application Programming Interface**）实现对微控制器片上外设和片下存储器映射外设的访问。任务：使较高的软件层次独立于微控制器。

Mode.en_definition: A Mode is a certain set of states of the various state machines that are running in the vehicle that are relevant to a particular entity, e.g. a SW-C, a BSW module, an application or a whole vehicle. In its lifetime, an entity changes between a set of mutually exclusive Modes. These changes are triggered by environmental data, e.g. signal reception, operation invocation.
Mode.zh: 模式（**Mode**）是车辆中运行的各状态机中与特定实体（例如 SW-C、BSW 模块、应用或整车）相关的某一组状态。在其生存期内，实体在一组互斥的模式之间切换。这些切换由环境数据触发，例如信号接收、操作调用。

Multimedia Stream.en_definition: A consistent sequence of digital data versus time which is suited as input for devices which transfer these data into a continuous visible or audible impression to humans. When transferred over a physical link, multimedia stream data typically are produced at the same rate (by the data source), as they are consumed (by the data sinks).
Multimedia Stream.zh: 随时间变化的一致的数字数据序列，适合作为那些将这些数据转换为对人类连续可见或可听印象的设备的输入。通过物理链路传输时，多媒体流数据通常以与数据汇消耗它们相同的速率（由数据源）产生。

Multiplexed PDU.en_definition: A multiplexed PDU is a PDU with a configurable number of different payload layouts.
Multiplexed PDU.zh: 多路复用 PDU（**Multiplexed PDU**）是具有可配置数量的不同有效载荷布局的 PDU。

Network.zh: AUTOSAR ECU/机器之间的通信基础设施。

Network Interface.en_definition: A Network Interface is the sum of all interfaces offered by the 'Basic Software' towards its connected network.
Network Interface.zh: 网络接口（**Network Interface**）是"基础软件"（**Basic Software**）向其所连接的网络提供的全部接口的总和。

NM Coordination Cluster.en_definition: A discrete set of NM Channels on which shutdown is coordinated.
NM Coordination Cluster.zh: 协调关机的一组离散 NM 信道（**NM Channel**）。

NM Coordinator.en_definition: A functionality of the Generic NM Interface which allows coordination of network sleep for multiple NM Channels.
NM Coordinator.zh: 通用 NM 接口（**Generic NM Interface**）的一种功能，允许多个 NM 信道之间协调网络休眠。

Non-repudiation.en_definition: Concept that is used in information security that assures that the sender of information is provided with proof of delivery and the recipient is provided with proof of the sender's identity, so neither can later deny having processed the information.
Non-repudiation.zh: 信息安全中使用的一种概念，确保信息发送方获得送达证明，接收方获得发送方身份证明，从而使双方事后都不能否认处理过该信息。

Notification.en_definition: Informing a software entity about a state change of a hardware and/or software entity which has occurred.
Notification.zh: 将已经发生的硬件和/或软件实体的状态改变告知某个软件实体。

Onboard Security Event.en_definition: Analog to ISO/IEC 27000:2018 ([44]) an onboard security event (SEv) is the identified occurrence of an onboard system, service or network state indicating a possible breach of information security policy or failure of controls, or a previously unknown situation that can be security relevant.
Onboard Security Event.zh: 类比 ISO/IEC 27000:2018（[44]），车载安全事件（**SEv**）是已识别的车载系统、服务或网络状态的出现，它指示可能违反信息安全策略或控制措施失效，或者是先前未知的、可能具有安全相关性的情形。

OS Application.en_definition: A block of software including tasks, interrupts, hooks and user services that form a cohesive functional unit.
OS Application.zh: 包括任务、中断、钩子和用户服务在内、构成一个内聚功能单元的软件块。

OS Event.en_definition: The event mechanism • is a means of synchronization • is only provided for extended tasks • initiates state transitions of tasks to and from the waiting state.
OS Event.zh: 事件机制：• 是一种同步手段 • 仅为扩展任务提供 • 引发任务在等待状态之间进行状态转换。

Protocol Control Information.en_definition: Information which is needed to pass a 'Service Data Unit' from one instance of a specific protocol layer to another instance. E.g. it contains source and target information.
Protocol Control Information.zh: 将"服务数据单元"（**Service Data Unit**）从一个特定协议层的实例传递到另一个实例所需的信息。例如它包含源和目标信息。

Protocol Data Unit.en_definition: The Protocol Data Unit (PDU) contains 'Service Data Unit' and 'Protocol Control Information'.
Protocol Data Unit.zh: 协议数据单元（**Protocol Data Unit**, PDU）包含"服务数据单元"（**Service Data Unit**）和"协议控制信息"（**Protocol Control Information**）。

PDU Meta-Data.en_definition: Additional data of a 'Protocol Data Unit', which is not part of the payload.
PDU Meta-Data.zh: "协议数据单元"（**Protocol Data Unit**）的附加数据，不属于有效载荷。

PDU Timeout.en_definition: Maximum time between the receptions of two instances of one PDU is exceeded.
PDU Timeout.zh: 超过一个 PDU 的两个实例被接收之间的最大时间。

Performance.en_definition: Performance is a set of measurable characteristics (e.g. time, memory, resources usage, power consumption, etc.) which may be used to compare different system, SW element, algorithm, etc. implementations.
Performance.zh: 性能（**Performance**）是一组可测量的特征（例如时间、内存、资源使用、功耗等），可用于比较不同的系统、软件元素、算法等的实现。

Peripheral Hardware.en_definition: Hardware devices integrated in micro-controller architecture to interact with the environment.
Peripheral Hardware.zh: 集成在微控制器架构中、用于与环境交互的硬件设备。

Personalization.en_definition: User-specific and memorized adjustment of SW data or selection of functional alternatives.
Personalization.zh: 用户特定的、被记忆保存的 SW 数据调整或功能备选项选择。

Plausibility.en_definition: Runtime Plausibility check is a method to verify during runtime if inputs for a computation/ algorithm or results of a computation/algorithm are reasonable against corresponding values of a simplified reference model.
Plausibility.zh: 运行时合理性检查（**Plausibility**）是一种在运行期间验证计算/算法的输入或结果相对于简化参考模型的对应值是否合理的方法。

PNC Leaf Node.en_definition: A PNC leaf node is located beneath a 'Top-level PNC Coordinator' or 'Intermediate PNC Coordinator'. A PNC leaf node represents the lowest level within the hierarchy of a PN topology. A PNC leaf node does not coordinate PNC request across its local communication channels. It receives and transmits Nm frames with PN information, but it does not forward received PNC requests to other local communication channels. A PNC leaf node processes PN shutdown messages as usual Nm frames with PN information.
PNC Leaf Node.zh: PNC 叶节点（**PNC Leaf Node**）位于"顶层 PNC 协调器"（**Top-level PNC Coordinator**）或"中间 PNC 协调器"（**Intermediate PNC Coordinator**）之下。PNC 叶节点代表 PN 拓扑层级中的最低层级。PNC 叶节点不跨其本地通信信道协调 PNC 请求。它接收和发送带 PN 信息的 Nm 帧，但不将收到的 PNC 请求转发到其他本地通信信道。PNC 叶节点将 PN 关机报文当作普通的带 PN 信息的 Nm 帧处理。

PN shutdown message.en_definition: A 'Top-level PNC Coordinator' transmits the PN shutdown messages to indicate a PNC shutdown. A PN shutdown message is a NM message where the PNSR bit (resides in the control bit vector) and all PNC bits (resides in the PN info) which are indicated for a synchronized shutdown set to '1'. A receiving 'Intermediate PNC Coordinator' has to process the PN shutdown message immediately, reset the PN reset timer and forward the PN information as fast as possible to ensure a synchronized shutdown of the affected PNCs at nearly the same point in time. A 'PNC Leaf Node' acts independently of the PNSR bit and resets the PN reset timer.
PN shutdown message.zh: "顶层 PNC 协调器"（**Top-level PNC Coordinator**）发送 PN 关机报文以指示 PNC 关机。PN 关机报文是一种 Nm 报文，其中 PNSR 位（位于控制位向量中）和所有被指示为同步关机的 PNC 位（位于 PN 信息中）被置为"1"。接收方的"中间 PNC 协调器"（**Intermediate PNC Coordinator**）必须立即处理 PN 关机报文，重置 PN 复位定时器，并尽快转发 PN 信息，以确保受影响的 PNC 几乎在同一时间点同步关机。"PNC 叶节点"（**PNC Leaf Node**）的行为与 PNSR 位无关，并重置 PN 复位定时器。

Policy Decision Point (PDP).en_definition: The PDP represents the logic in which the access control decision is made. It determines if the application is allowed to perform the requested task.
Policy Decision Point (PDP).zh: PDP（策略决策点）表示做出访问控制决策的逻辑。它确定是否允许应用执行所请求的任务。

Policy Enforcement Point (PEP).en_definition: The PEP represents the logic in which the 'Access Control Decision' is enforced. It communicates directly with the corresponding 'Policy Decision Point (PDP)' to receive the 'Access Control Decision'.
Policy Enforcement Point (PEP).zh: PEP（策略执行点）表示执行"访问控制判定"（**Access Control Decision**）的逻辑。它直接与相应的"策略决策点（**Policy Decision Point (PDP)**）"通信以接收访问控制判定。

Port.en_definition: A port belongs to a 'Software Component' and is the interaction point between the component and other components. The interaction between specific ports of specific components is modeled using Connectors ('Connector'). A port can either be a 'Provide Port' or an 'Require Port'.
Port.zh: 端口（**Port**）属于一个"软件组件"（**Software Component**），是该组件与其他组件之间的交互点。特定组件的特定端口之间的交互使用连接器（**Connector**）建模。端口可以是"提供端口"（**Provide Port**）或"需求端口"（**Require Port**）。

Port Interface.en_definition: A Port Interface characterizes the information provided or required by a 'Port' of a 'Software Component'.
Port Interface.zh: 端口接口（**Port Interface**）刻画"软件组件"（**Software Component**）的某个"端口"（**Port**）所提供或所需的信息。

Post-build Time Configuration.en_definition: The configuration of the SW module is possible after building the SW module.
Post-build Time Configuration.zh: SW 模块的配置可以在构建 SW 模块之后进行。

Post-build Hooking.en_definition: The insertion of Hooks to facilitate Rapid Prototyping support into a (complete) ECU hex image.
Post-build Hooking.zh: 将便于快速原型支持的钩子（**Hook**）插入（完整的）ECU hex 镜像。

Pre-build Hooking.en_definition: The insertion of Hooks to facilitate Rapid Prototyping support into software source prior to creating an ECU hex image.
Pre-build Hooking.zh: 在创建 ECU hex 镜像之前，将便于快速原型支持的钩子（**Hook**）插入软件源代码。

Pre-Compile Time Configuration.en_definition: The configuration of the SW module is done at source code level and will be effective after compile time.
Pre-Compile Time Configuration.zh: SW 模块的配置在源代码级别完成，并在编译期之后生效。

Predictabiliy.en_definition: Predictability is the degree to which a correct prediction or forecast of a system's state / behavior can be made either qualitatively or quantitatively.
Predictabiliy.zh: 可预测性（**Predictability**）是指能够对系统的状态/行为做出正确的定性或定量预测或预估的程度。

Pretended Networking.en_definition: Method to reduce energy consumption in an existing active network without changing network infrastructure.
Pretended Networking.zh: 在不改变网络基础设施的情况下，降低现有活动网络中能耗的方法。

Private Interface.en_definition: A private interface is an interface within the 'Basic Software' of AUTOSAR which is neither standardized nor defined within AUTOSAR.
Private Interface.zh: 私有接口（**Private Interface**）是 AUTOSAR"基础软件"（**Basic Software**）内部的接口，既未被标准化也未在 AUTOSAR 中定义。

Probability of Failure.en_definition: Probability of the occurrence of a failure in a system or functional unit.
Probability of Failure.zh: 系统或功能单元中发生失效（**Failure**）的概率。

Procedure Call.en_definition: A simple statement that provides the actual parameters for and invokes the execution of a procedure (software function).
Procedure Call.zh: 一种简单的语句，它为过程（软件函数）的执行提供实际参数并调用该执行。

Process.en_definition: An executable unit managed by an operating system scheduler that has its own name space and resources (including memory) protected against use from other processes.
Process.zh: 由操作系统调度器管理的可执行单元，它拥有自己的命名空间和资源（包括内存），并受保护不被其他进程使用。

Processed Manifest.en_definition: A Processed Manifest is a Manifest that is stored in the implementation specific format on the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform product. Usually this is done in combination with other artifacts (like binary files) that contain executable code to which the Manifest applies.
Processed Manifest.zh: 已处理清单（**Processed Manifest**）是以实现特定格式存储在 AUTOSAR 自适应平台产品上的清单。通常这与其他包含清单所适用可执行代码的制品（如二进制文件）一起完成。

Profiling.en_definition: Profiling refers to the process of evaluating 'Performance'.
Profiling.zh: 性能剖析（**Profiling**）指评估"性能"（**Performance**）的过程。

Provide Port.en_definition: Specific 'Port' providing Data or providing a service of a Server.
Provide Port.zh: 提供数据或提供服务器服务的特定"端口"（**Port**）。

Rapid Prototyping.en_definition: The experimental incorporation of new functionality.
Rapid Prototyping.zh: 以实验方式并入新功能。

Rapid Prototyping Memory Interface.en_definition: The memory access pattern necessary for 'Rapid Prototyping Tool'.
Rapid Prototyping Memory Interface.zh: "快速原型工具"（**Rapid Prototyping Tool**）所必需的内存访问模式。

Rapid Prototyping Tool.en_definition: Software and/ or hardware tools to support 'Rapid Prototyping'.
Rapid Prototyping Tool.zh: 支持"快速原型"（**Rapid Prototyping**）的软件和/或硬件工具。

Rate Conversion.en_definition: Operation to change the timing between two transmissions of the same PduId on one physical Network.
Rate Conversion.zh: 改变同一 PduId 在一个物理网络上两次传输之间时序的操作。

Raw Data Stream.en_definition: A Raw Data Stream is a collection of data that is unprocessed, basically a series of bytes without any information on how to interpret it.
Raw Data Stream.zh: 原始数据流（**Raw Data Stream**）是未处理的数据集合，基本上是一系列字节，不带有任何关于如何解释它们的信息。

Recovery.en_definition: Returning to intended functionality after fault detection without violating the safety goals.
Recovery.zh: 在故障检测后恢复到预期功能，而不违反安全目标。

Redundancy.en_definition: Existence of means in addition to the means that would be sufficient for an element to perform a required function or to represent information. Hardware element redundancy includes replicated or additional hardware means added to the system to support fault tolerance. Software element redundancy includes the additional SW units and/or data used to support fault tolerance.
Redundancy.zh: 在足以使元素执行所需功能或表示信息的手段之外，还存在额外的手段。硬件元素冗余包括为支持容错而添加到系统中的复制或附加的硬件手段。软件元素冗余包括用于支持容错的附加软件单元和/或数据。

Reentrancy.en_definition: In AUTOSAR a Function is called reentrant if it can be interrupted in the middle of its execution and then safely called again ("re-entered") before its previous invocations complete execution. AUTOSAR differs between • (full) reentrancy • non reentrancy and • conditional reentrancy.
Reentrancy.zh: 在 AUTOSAR 中，如果一个函数可以在其执行过程中被中断，并且在其先前的调用完成执行之前被安全地再次调用（"重入"），则该函数称为可重入函数。AUTOSAR 区分：•（完全）可重入 • 不可重入 • 条件可重入。

Reliability.en_definition: Probability of a system or functional unit to perform as expected under specified conditions within a time interval.
Reliability.zh: 系统或功能单元在规定条件下、在给定时间区间内按预期执行的概率。

Relocatability.en_definition: Capability of a software part being executed on different hardware environments without changing the code of the software part.
Relocatability.zh: 软件部件能够在不同硬件环境中执行而不改变该软件部件代码的能力。

Require Port.en_definition: Specific 'Port' requiring Data or requiring a service of a server.
Require Port.zh: 需要数据或需要服务器服务的特定"端口"（**Port**）。

Required Property.en_definition: A required property or quality of a design entity (e.g. SW component or system) is a property or quality which has to be fulfilled by the environment of this design entity.
Required Property.zh: 设计实体（例如软件组件或系统）的"被要求的属性或质量"（**Required Property**）是指必须由该设计实体的环境来满足的属性或质量。

Residual Error Rate.en_definition: The ratio of the number of bits, unit elements, or blocks incorrectly received and undetected, to the total number of bits, unit elements, characters, or blocks sent.
Residual Error Rate.zh: 接收错误且未被检测到的位、单元元素或块的数量，除以已发送的位、单元元素、字符或块的总数所得的比值。

Resource.en_definition: A resource is a required but limited hardware entity of an 'Electronic Control Unit', which in general can be accessed concurrently, but not simultaneously, by multiple software entities.
Resource.zh: 资源（**Resource**）是"电子控制单元"（**Electronic Control Unit**）的必需但有限的硬件实体，一般可以被多个软件实体并发访问，但不能同时访问。

Resource-Management.en_definition: Entity which controls the use of Resources ('Resource').

Response Time.en_definition: Time between receiving a stimulus and delivering an appropriate response or reaction.
Response Time.zh: 从接收激励到交付适当响应或反应之间的时间。

Robustness.en_definition: Ability of a system or functional unit to perform as expected also under unexpected conditions.
Robustness.zh: 系统或功能单元即使在意外条件下也能按预期执行的能力。

RTE Event.en_definition: An RTE Event encompasses all possible situations that can trigger execution of a 'Runnable Entity' by the RTE. Thus they can address timing, data sending and receiving, invoking operations, call server returning, mode switching, or external events. RTE Events can either activate a runnable entity or wake-up a runnable entity at its waitpoints.
RTE Event.zh: RTE 事件（**RTE Event**）涵盖能够触发 RTE 执行"可运行实体"（**Runnable Entity**）的所有可能情形。因此它们可以涉及时序、数据发送与接收、操作调用、服务器调用返回、模式切换或外部事件。RTE 事件可以激活一个可运行实体，或在其等待点唤醒一个可运行实体。

Runnable Entity.en_definition: A Runnable Entity is a part of an 'Atomic Software Component' which can be executed and scheduled independently from the other Runnable Entities of this Atomic Software-Component. It is described by a sequence of instructions that can be started by the RTE. Each runnable entity is associated with exactly one Entry Point.
Runnable Entity.zh: 可运行实体（**Runnable Entity**）是"原子软件组件"（**Atomic Software Component**）的一部分，可以独立于该原子软件组件的其他可运行实体被执行和调度。它由一串可由 RTE 启动的指令描述。每个可运行实体恰好关联一个"入口点"（**Entry Point**）。

SAE J1939.en_definition: SAE J1939 is a vehicle bus standard created by the SAE (Society of Automotive Engineers, a USA standards body) for car and heavy duty truck industries.
SAE J1939.zh: SAE J1939 是由 SAE（美国汽车工程师学会，美国的标准机构）为轿车和重型卡车行业创建的车载总线标准。

Safety Analysis.en_definition: The objective of safety analyses is to examine the consequences of faults and failures on items and elements considering their functions, behaviour and design.
Safety Analysis.zh: 安全分析的目的是在考虑其功能、行为和设计的前提下，检查故障和失效对项目与元素造成的后果。

Safety Protocol.en_definition: A communication protocol defining the necessary mechanisms to ensure the integrity of transmitted data and to detect any communication related error.
Safety Protocol.zh: 一种通信协议，定义了确保所传输数据完整性并检测任何与通信相关错误所需的机制。

Sample Application.en_definition: Defined system used for evaluation purposes.
Sample Application.zh: 用于评估目的的已定义系统。

Scalability.en_definition: The degree to which assets can be adapted to specific target environments for various defined measures.
Scalability.zh: 资产能够按各种已定义的度量被适配到特定目标环境的程度。

Scheduler.en_definition: The scheduler handles the scheduling of the tasks/runnable entities ('Task' / 'Runnable Entity') according to the priority and scheduling policy (pre-defined or configurable). It has the responsibility to decide during run-time when which task can run on on the CPU of the ECU.
Scheduler.zh: 调度器（**Scheduler**）根据优先级和调度策略（预定义的或可配置的）处理任务/可运行实体（"任务"（**Task**）/"可运行实体"（**Runnable Entity**））的调度。它负责在运行期间决定哪个任务何时可以在 ECU 的 CPU 上运行。

Service Data Unit.en_definition: Service Data Unit is the data passed by an upper layer, with the request to transmit the data. It is as well the data, which is extracted after reception by the lower layer and passed to the upper layer.
Service Data Unit.zh: 服务数据单元（**Service Data Unit**）是上层为请求传输而传递的数据。它也是下层在接收后提取并传递给上层的数据。

Security.en_definition: Protection of data, software entities or resources from accidental or malicious acts.
Security.zh: 保护数据、软件实体或资源免受意外或恶意行为的影响。

Secure Channel.en_definition: A secure channel is a communication channel between two parties. A secure channel shall at least provide integrity and authenticity of the communication. It shall provide means to authenticate at least one participant of the communication. It may provide means to mutually authenticate both participants of the communication. A secure channel may additionally provide the confidentiality of the communication.
Secure Channel.zh: 安全通道（**Secure Channel**）是两方之间的通信信道。安全通道至少应提供通信的完整性和真实性。它应提供至少对通信一方进行身份验证的手段。它可以提供对通信双方进行相互身份验证的手段。安全通道还可以额外提供通信的机密性。

Security Event.en_definition: An event which is related to the security of the ECU and should be reported for later analysis.
Security Event.zh: 与 ECU 安全相关、应被报告以供后续分析的事件。

Sender-Receiver Communication.en_definition: A communication pattern which offers asyncronous distribution of information where a sender communicates information to one or more receivers, or a receiver receives information from one or several senders.
Sender-Receiver Communication.zh: 一种通信模式，它提供信息的异步分发：发送方将信息传送给一个或多个接收方，或接收方从一个或多个发送方接收信息。

Sender-Receiver Interface.en_definition: A sender-receiver interface is a special kind of 'Port Interface' for the case of 'Sender-Receiver Communication'. The sender-receiver interface defines the data-elements which are sent by a sending component (which has a p-port providing the sender-receiver interface) or received by a receiving component (which has an r-port requiring the sender-receiver interface).
Sender-Receiver Interface.zh: 发送方-接收方接口（**Sender-Receiver Interface**）是一种特殊的"端口接口"（**Port Interface**），用于"发送方-接收方通信"（**Sender-Receiver Communication**）的情形。发送方-接收方接口定义了由发送组件（拥有提供该发送方-接收方接口的 p 端口）发送、或由接收组件（拥有需要该发送方-接收方接口的 r 端口）接收的数据元素。

Sensor/Actuator SW-Component.en_definition: 'Software Component' dedicated to the control of a sensor or actuator.
Sensor/Actuator SW-Component.zh: 专用于控制传感器或执行器的"软件组件"（**Software Component**）。

Server.en_definition: Software entity which provides services for Clients
Server.zh: 为客户端提供服务的软件实体。

Service.en_definition: A service is a type of operation that has a published specification of interface and behavior, involving a contract between the provider of the capability and the potential clients.
Service.zh: 服务（**Service**）是一种操作类型，它具有已发布的接口和行为规范，涉及能力提供方与潜在客户端之间的契约。

Service Discovery.en_definition: Generic functionality provided by the Communication Management to Applications that allows Applications at runtime to find locally or remotely available Service Instances providing the requested service.
Service Discovery.zh: 由通信管理（**Communication Management**）向应用提供的通用功能，允许应用在运行时找到提供所请求服务的、本地或远程可用的服务实例。

Service Instance.en_definition: The properties of a service instance are described by a specific service interface. A service instance has a unique identity.
Service Instance.zh: 服务实例（**Service Instance**）的属性由特定的服务接口描述。服务实例具有唯一的身份。

Service Interface.en_definition: A service interface is a special kind of port interface (see Port Interface) used in the Adaptive platform. It defines both data elements for event based communication and operations that are provided by the service provider and that can be used by the service requester.
Service Interface.zh: 服务接口（**Service Interface**）是在自适应平台中使用的一种特殊的端口接口（参见 Port Interface）。它既定义基于事件通信的数据元素，也定义由服务提供者提供、可被服务请求者使用的操作。

Service Oriented Communication.en_definition: Communication, for which communication partners are generally not defined during design time, but dynamically discovered and bound during runtime.
Service Oriented Communication.zh: 通信伙伴一般不在设计期定义、而是在运行期间动态发现和绑定的通信。

Service Port.en_definition: Special kind of a 'Port' of a 'Atomic Software Component' used to describe service communication.
Service Port.zh: "原子软件组件"（**Atomic Software Component**）的一种特殊"端口"（**Port**），用于描述服务通信。

Service Proxy.en_definition: A facade that represents a specific service on code level from the perspective of the service consumer providing methods for all functionalities offered by the represented service.
Service Proxy.zh: 从服务消费者的角度在代码级别代表特定服务的一个外观（**facade**），它为所代表服务提供的所有功能提供了相应的方法。

Service Skeleton.en_definition: A representation of a specific service on code level from the perspective of the service implementation, which provides functionalities according to the service definition and allows to connect the service implementation to the Communication Management transport layer, so that the service implementation can be contacted by service consumers.
Service Skeleton.zh: 从服务实现的角度在代码级别对特定服务的表示，它按照服务定义提供功能，并允许将服务实现连接到通信管理的传输层，使服务实现能够被服务消费者联系。

Services Layer.en_definition: The Services Layer is the highest layer of the Basic Software which also applies for its relevance for the application software: while access to I/O signals is covered by the Hardware Abstraction Layer, the Services Layer offers Operating system services Vehicle network communication and management services Memory services (NVRAM management) Diagnosis Services (including KWP2000 interface and error memory) ECU state management Task: Provide basic services for application and basic software modules
Services Layer.zh: 服务层（**Services Layer**）是基础软件的最高层，这也决定了它与应用软件的相关性：对 I/O 信号的访问由硬件抽象层负责，而服务层提供：操作系统服务、车辆网络通信与管理服务、存储服务（NVRAM 管理）、诊断服务（包括 KWP2000 接口和错误存储器）、ECU 状态管理。任务：为应用和基础软件模块提供基础服务。

Signal Service Translation.en_definition: Signal Service Translation is the standardized way to map the definition of signal-based communication to service-oriented communication, and vice versa.
Signal Service Translation.zh: 信号服务转换（**Signal Service Translation**）是将基于信号的通信的定义映射到面向服务的通信、以及反向映射的标准化方式。

Slave Switch.en_definition: A Slave Switch is an Ethernet switch which is connected to a master switch by uplink ports
Slave Switch.zh: 从交换机（**Slave Switch**）是通过上行端口连接到主交换机的以太网交换机。

Software Cluster (Adaptive Platform).en_definition: An Adaptive Platform Software Cluster groups all AUTOSAR artifacts which are relevant for deployment on an Adaptive Platform Machine. The content of a Software Cluster is dependent on the category and "may" (but is not limited to) contain artifacts such as: • Adaptive Platform Applications (Executables) • Adaptive Platform Functional Clusters (Modules) • Manifests • Persistent Storage Databases • Platform libraries, e.g. Transformers, Cryptographics • Bootloader
Software Cluster (Adaptive Platform).zh: 自适应平台软件集群（**Software Cluster**）将所有与在自适应平台机器（**Machine**）上部署相关的 AUTOSAR 制品分组在一起。软件集群的内容取决于其类别，"可以"（但不限于）包含诸如以下制品：• 自适应平台应用（可执行文件） • 自适应平台功能簇（模块） • 清单 • 持久化存储数据库 • 平台库，例如转换器（**Transformers**）、加密（**Cryptographics**） • 引导加载程序

Software Component.en_definition: Software-Components are architectural elements that provide and/or require interfaces and are connected to each other through the Virtual Function Bus to fulfill architectural responsibilities.
Software Component.zh: 软件组件（**Software Component**）是提供和/或需要接口的架构元素，它们通过虚拟功能总线彼此连接，以履行架构职责。

Software Component Interface.en_definition: A SoftWare-Component Interface (SW-CI) is the sum of all interfaces offered by the 'Basic Software' towards the 'Software Component'.
