Software Component Interface.zh: 软件组件接口（**SW-CI**）是"基础软件"（**Basic Software**）向"软件组件"（**Software Component**）提供的全部接口的总和。

Software Configuration.en_definition: The arrangement of software elements in a SW system.
Software Configuration.zh: SW 系统中软件元素的布置。

Software Interrupt.zh: 由软件事件触发的中断。

Software Package.en_definition: Unit for deployment of software onto Adaptive AUTOSAR Platform instances containing zero or more executables and the meta-data to install and execute it on the Machine.
Software Package.zh: 用于将软件部署到自适应 AUTOSAR 平台实例上的单元，包含零个或多个可执行文件以及在该机器（**Machine**）上安装和执行它们的元数据。

Software Platform.en_definition: Software environment on which application software is executed.
Software Platform.zh: 执行应用软件的软件环境。

Software Signal.en_definition: A Software Signal is an asynchronous event transmitted between one process and another.
Software Signal.zh: 软件信号（**Software Signal**）是在进程与进程之间传输的异步事件。

Special Periphery Access.en_definition: Special functions to standard peripheral devices or special peripherals.
Special Periphery Access.zh: 访问标准外设设备或特殊外设的特殊函数。

Standard Periphery Access.en_definition: Standard functions to typical standard peripheral devices that are available on an ECU (most microcontroller integrated) used in automotive embedded applications.
Standard Periphery Access.zh: 针对汽车嵌入式应用中使用的 ECU（大多数为微控制器集成）上可用的典型标准外设设备的标准函数。

Standard Software.en_definition: Standard Software is software which provides schematic independent infrastructural functionalities on an ECU. It contains only Standardized AUTOSAR Interfaces ('Standardized AUTOSAR Interface'), Standardized Interfaces ('Standardized Interface') and/or Private Interfaces ('Private Interface').
Standard Software.zh: 标准软件（**Standard Software**）是在 ECU 上提供独立于原理图的基础设施功能的软件。它只包含标准化的 AUTOSAR 接口（**Standardized AUTOSAR Interface**）、标准化接口（**Standardized Interface**）和/或私有接口（**Private Interface**）。

Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint.en_definition: A Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint is a 'Blueprint' standardized within the AUTOSAR project. Its derived objects are considered as being standardized within the AUTOSAR project as well.
Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint.zh: 标准化 AUTOSAR 蓝图（**Standardized AUTOSAR Blueprint**）是在 AUTOSAR 项目内标准化的"蓝图"（**Blueprint**）。其派生对象也被视为在 AUTOSAR 项目内标准化。

Standardized AUTOSAR Interface.en_definition: This is an AUTOSAR Interface which is standardized within the AUTOSAR project.
Standardized AUTOSAR Interface.zh: 这是在 AUTOSAR 项目内标准化的 AUTOSAR 接口（**AUTOSAR Interface**）。

Standardized Blueprint.en_definition: A 'Blueprint' is called a Standardized Blueprint if the derived objects are considered as being standardized as well. It also includes that additionally concrete standardized rules exist how to specify the blueprint as well as how to derive an object from that blueprint. This is typically not done for a specific blueprint but for all blueprints of the same class.
Standardized Blueprint.zh: 如果"蓝图"（**Blueprint**）的派生对象也被视为标准化，则该蓝图称为标准化蓝图（**Standardized Blueprint**）。它还包括：额外存在具体的标准化规则，规定如何规定蓝图以及如何从该蓝图派生对象。这通常不是针对某个特定蓝图，而是针对同一类的所有蓝图进行的。

Standardized Interface.en_definition: A software interface is called Standardized Interface if a concrete standardized API exists.
Standardized Interface.zh: 如果存在具体的标准化 API，则软件接口称为标准化接口（**Standardized Interface**）。

Static Configuration.en_definition: A setup where the routing configuration cannot be changed during normal operation of the gateway.
Static Configuration.zh: 路由配置在网关正常运行期间无法改变的设置。

Synchronization Points.en_definition: Used to synchronize the execution of EEs of different tasks that execute within the same LET interval. A synchronization point realizes the execution order of EEs that belong to different EECs.
Synchronization Points.zh: 用于同步在同一 LET 区间内执行的不同任务的 EE 的执行。同步点（**Synchronization Point**）实现属于不同 EEC 的 EE 的执行顺序。

Synchronize.en_definition: To make two or more events or operations to occur at the same predefined moment in time.
Synchronize.zh: 使两个或多个事件或操作在同一预定义时刻发生。

Synchronous Communication.en_definition: A communication is synchronous when the calling software entity is blocked until the called operation is evaluated. The calling software entity continues its operation by getting the result.
Synchronous Communication.zh: 当调用方软件实体被阻塞、直到被调用的操作完成求值时，该通信是同步的。调用方软件实体通过获得结果继续其操作。

Synchronous Function.en_definition: A function is called synchronous if the described functionality is guaranteed to be completed the moment the function returns to the caller.
Synchronous Function.zh: 如果某函数所描述的功能在该函数返回调用者时保证已完成，则该函数称为同步函数。

System.en_definition: Representation of software related parts in a vehicle and their means to communicate with each other.
System.zh: 车辆中软件相关部分的表示，以及它们彼此通信的方式。

System Constraint.en_definition: Boundary conditions that restrict the Design-Freedom of the (cars E/E-) System.
System Constraint.zh: 限制（汽车 E/E）系统设计自由度的边界条件。

System Health Monitor.en_definition: System Health Monitor (SHM) analyzes the health of subsystems.
System Health Monitor.zh: 系统健康监控器（**System Health Monitor**, SHM）分析子系统的健康状况。

System Signal.en_definition: The system signal represents the communication system's view of data exchanged between SW components which reside on different ECUs. The system signals allow to represent this communication in a flattened structure, with (at least) one system signal defined for each data element sent or received by a SW component instance. If data has to be sent over gateways, there is still only one system signal representing this data. The representation of the data on the individual communication systems is done by the cluster signals.
System Signal.zh: 系统信号（**System Signal**）表示通信系统对驻留在不同 ECU 上的 SW 组件之间交换的数据的视图。系统信号允许以扁平化的结构表示这种通信，为每个 SW 组件实例发送或接收的数据元素定义（至少）一个系统信号。如果数据必须经由网关发送，仍然只有一个系统信号表示该数据。数据在各个通信系统上的表示由簇信号（**Cluster Signal**）完成。

Task.en_definition: A Task is the smallest schedulable unit managed by the OS. The OS decides when which task can run on the CPU of the ECU.
Task.zh: 任务（**Task**）是由 OS 管理的最小可调度单元。OS 决定哪个任务何时可以在 ECU 的 CPU 上运行。

Technical Signal.en_definition: The technical signal is the physical value of an external event coupled to an AUTOSAR system. Technical signals are represented in SI units (e.g. pressure in PA).
Technical Signal.zh: 技术信号（**Technical Signal**）是与 AUTOSAR 系统耦合的外部事件的物理值。技术信号以 SI 单位表示（例如压力以 Pa 表示）。

Timed Communication.en_definition: Implicit communication with logical publication at the end of a LET interval and logical read at the beginning of a LET interval. Access to the timed communication buffer is available for all EEs that reference the LET interval through EECs.
Timed Communication.zh: 在 LET 区间末尾逻辑发布、在 LET 区间开头逻辑读取的隐式通信。对于通过 EEC 引用该 LET 区间的所有 EE，都可以访问定时通信（**Timed Communication**）缓冲区。

Timeout.en_definition: Notification with respect to deadline violation of an event or task (e.g. while working on/with information: receiving, sending, processing, etc.).
Timeout.zh: 针对事件或任务的截止期限违反而给出的通知（例如在处理信息期间：接收、发送、处理等）。

Top-level PNC Coordinator.en_definition: The top-level PNC (Partial Network Cluster) coordinator is the topmost coordinator in a PN topology, the single root of the directed acyclic graph forming the logical partial network cluster for particular PNCs. The top-level PNC coordinator is responsible for the coordinated shutdown of all PNC members, because it is the only node which has the full overview of the states of all PNCs. Only the PNC top-level coordinator is allowed to send a PN shutdown messages. Note that for different PNCs it is possible to have different top-level PNC coordinators. For the same PNC only one top-level coordinator is supported.
Top-level PNC Coordinator.zh: 顶层 PNC 协调器（**Top-level PNC Coordinator**）是 PN 拓扑中的最顶层协调器，是构成特定 PNC 的逻辑部分网络集群的有向无环图的唯一根。顶层 PNC 协调器负责所有 PNC 成员的协调关机，因为它是唯一拥有所有 PNC 状态完整概览的节点。只有 PNC 顶层协调器才允许发送 PN 关机报文。注意，对于不同的 PNC，可以有不同的顶层 PNC 协调器。对于同一个 PNC，只支持一个顶层协调器。

Tracing.en_definition: Tracing is the activity of recording a program's observable state and execution path within the system over a certain period of time.
Tracing.zh: 跟踪（**Tracing**）是在一定时间段内记录程序在系统中的可观测状态和执行路径的活动。

Uplink Port.en_definition: A Uplink Port is a port of an automotive Ethernet switch which is connected to another Ethernet automotive switch (cascaded switch). A Uplink Port could either be an internal port or an external port. One Uplink Port is connected to another Uplink Port. The Uplink Port has a special role from the perspective of the software.
Uplink Port.zh: 上行端口（**Uplink Port**）是汽车以太网交换机上连接到另一台汽车以太网交换机（级联交换机）的端口。上行端口可以是内部端口或外部端口。一个上行端口连接到另一个上行端口。从软件的角度看，上行端口具有特殊角色。

Use Case.en_definition: A use case defines a list of actions defining the interactions between actors and a system to achieve a goal.
Use Case.zh: 用例（**Use Case**）定义了一组动作，用于刻画参与者与系统之间为达成某个目标而进行的交互。

Validation.en_definition: Confirmation by examination and provisions of objective evidence that the particular requirements for a specific intended use are fulfilled.
Validation.zh: 通过检查和提供客观证据，确认针对特定预期用途的特定要求已得到满足。

Variability.en_definition: Variability of a system is its quality to describe a set of variants. These variants are characterized by variant specific property settings and / or selections.
Variability.zh: 系统的可变性（**Variability**）是系统描述一组变体的性质。这些变体的特征是变体特定的属性设置和/或选择。

Variant.en_definition: A system variant is a concrete realization of a system, so that all its properties have been set respectively selected. The software system has no variability anymore with respect to the binding time.
Variant.zh: 系统变体（**Variant**）是系统的一个具体实现，其所有属性都已被设置或选择。就绑定时间而言，该软件系统不再具有可变性。

Variant Coding.en_definition: Adaptation of SW by selection of functional alternatives according to external requirements (e.g. country-dependent or legal restrictions).
Variant Coding.zh: 根据外部需求（例如国家相关或法律限制），通过选择功能备选项来调整软件。

Variation Binding.en_definition: A variant is the result of a variation binding process that resolves the variability of the system by assigning particular values/selections to all the system's properties.
Variation Binding.zh: 变体是变体绑定（**Variation Binding**）过程的结果，该过程通过为系统的所有属性赋以特定的取值/选择来消解系统的可变性。

Variation Binding Time.en_definition: The variation binding time determines the step in the methodology at which the variability given by a set of variable properties is resolved.
Variation Binding Time.zh: 变体绑定时间（**Variation Binding Time**）确定方法论中由一组可变属性给出的可变性被消解的步骤。

Variation Point.en_definition: A variation point indicates that a property is subject to variation. Furthermore, it is associated with a condition and a binding time which define the system context for the selection / setting of a concrete variant.
Variation Point.zh: 变化点（**Variation Point**）指示某个属性是可变的。此外，它与一个条件和一个绑定时间相关联，后者定义了选择/设置具体变体的系统上下文。

Vehicle State Manager.en_definition: An OEM specific application that controls vehicle level state and interacts with various entities in the vehicle system.
Vehicle State Manager.zh: 控制整车级别状态、并与车辆系统中各实体交互的 OEM 特定应用。

Vehicle Variant.en_definition: A vehicle variant is a fully characterized product and a subset of the artifacts of the product line.
Vehicle Variant.zh: 车辆变体（**Vehicle Variant**）是一个被完整刻画的产品，是产品线制品的子集。

Vendor ID.en_definition: A vendor ID is a unique identification of the vendor of a software component. All basic software modules ('Basic Software Module') conforming to the AUTOSAR standard shall provide a readable vendor ID.
Vendor ID.zh: 供应商 ID（**Vendor ID**）是软件组件供应商的唯一标识。所有符合 AUTOSAR 标准的基础软件模块（**Basic Software Module**）都应提供一个可读的供应商 ID。

Verification.en_definition: Confirmation by examination and provisions of objective evidence that specified requirements have been fulfilled.
Verification.zh: 通过检查和提供客观证据，确认规定的要求已得到满足。

VFB View.en_definition: The VFB View describes systems or subsystems in the car independently of these resources; in other words, independently of: • what kind of and how many ECUs are present in the car • on what ECUs the entities in the VFB-View run • how the ECUs are interconnected: what kind of network technology (CAN, LIN, ...) and what kind of topology (presence of gateways) is used
VFB View.zh: VFB 视图（**VFB View**）独立于这些资源来描述汽车中的系统或子系统；换句话说，独立于：• 车中存在何种类型、多少个 ECU • VFB 视图中的实体运行在哪些 ECU 上 • ECU 如何互连：使用何种网络技术（CAN、LIN 等）以及何种拓扑（是否存在网关）。

Virtual Functional Bus.en_definition: The Virtual Functional Bus is an abstraction of the communication between Atomic Software Components ('Atomic Software Component') and AUTOSAR Services ('AUTOSAR Service'). This abstraction is such that specification of the communication mechanisms is independent from the concrete technology chosen to realize the communication.
Virtual Functional Bus.zh: 虚拟功能总线（**Virtual Functional Bus**）是"原子软件组件"（**Atomic Software Component**）和"AUTOSAR 服务"（**AUTOSAR Service**）之间通信的抽象。这一抽象使得通信机制的规范独立于为实现通信所选定的具体技术。

Virtual Integration.en_definition: The simulated, modeled and/or calculated (not real) combination of software entities forming a 'System'.
Virtual Integration.zh: 形成一个"系统"（**System**）的软件实体的仿真、建模和/或计算出来的（非真实的）组合。

Virtualization.en_definition: Virtualization is a mechanism which hides the physical characteristics of a computing platform from the users, presenting instead another abstract computing platform. It can be used to fulfill functional safety requirements like availability, partitioning, resource conflict management, recovery etc.
Virtualization.zh: 虚拟化（**Virtualization**）是一种向用户隐藏计算平台物理特性、而呈现另一个抽象计算平台的机制。它可以用于实现可用性、分区（**Partitioning**）、资源冲突管理、恢复（**Recovery**）等功能安全需求。

Wake-up and Sleep on Dataline.en_definition: Wake-up request or sleep request which is transmitted over a dataline of an Automotive Ethernet switched network.
Wake-up and Sleep on Dataline.zh: 通过汽车以太网交换网络的数据线传输的唤醒请求或休眠请求。

Worst Case Execution Time.en_definition: Maximum possible time during which a program is actually executing
Worst Case Execution Time.zh: 程序实际执行的最大可能时间。

Worst Case Response Time.en_definition: Maximum possible time between receiving a stimulus and delivering an appropriate response or reaction.
Worst Case Response Time.zh: 从接收激励到交付适当响应或反应之间的最大可能时间。
